# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Sequential Wet Bench Immersion Run & Marangoni Dry Execution
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-180NM-004`  
**Process Line:** Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line (180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Batch Load       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  SC-1 Megasonic Tank:  │
│   70-80 °C, 10-15 min  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  QDR / Dump Rinse 1:   │
│  18.2 MΩ·cm, 3 min     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   DHF 50:1 Strip:      │
│   25 °C, 15-30 sec     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  QDR / Dump Rinse 2:   │
│  18.2 MΩ·cm, 3 min     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    SC-2 Acid Tank:     │
│    70-80 °C, 10 min    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Final QDR / Overflow  │
│     Cascade Rinse      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Marangoni Vapor Dry   │
│    Chamber: IPA/N2     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Flight Safety & Bath Initialization**:
   - Verify safety station readiness: Confirm **Calcium Gluconate Gel** is present, unexpired, and accessible adjacent to the HF module.
   - Bath 1 (SC-1): Charge 5 parts DI H₂O, 1 part NH₄OH (29%), and 1 part H₂O₂ (30%). Set bath temperature controller to **70 °C – 80 °C**.
   - Bath 2 (DHF): Prepare 1:50 HF:H₂O solution at ambient cleanroom temperature (~25 °C).
   - Bath 3 (SC-2): Charge 6 parts DI H₂O, 1 part HCl (37%), and 1 part H₂O₂ (30%). Set bath temperature controller to **70 °C – 80 °C**.
   - Resistivity Sensor: Confirm ultra-pure DI water supply is at **18.2 MΩ·cm**.

2. **Automated Cassette Transfer to SC-1 (RCA-1 Clean)**:
   - Command the automated wet bench robotic end-effector to pick up the 180nm wafer boat and immerse it into the heated SC-1 tank.
   - Run immersion sequence for **10 to 15 minutes** at **70 °C – 80 °C** to strip gross organic contamination and light trace metals.

3. **Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR 1)**:
   - Transfer wafer boat automatically into QDR Tank 1.
   - Execute dump rinse cycles with 18.2 MΩ·cm DI water for **3 minutes** to completely clear alkaline residues.

4. **Automated DHF 50:1 Native Oxide Strip**:
   - Transfer wafer boat into the 1:50 HF tank.
   - Immersion dwell time: **15 to 30 seconds**.
   - Surface state transition: Confirm transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic state.

5. **Post-DHF Dump Rinse (QDR 2)**:
   - Rapidly transfer boat into QDR Tank 2 to prevent aerial re-oxidation and fluoride carryover.
   - Execute dump rinse cycles with 18.2 MΩ·cm DI water for **3 minutes**.

6. **Automated SC-2 Immersion (RCA-2 Clean)**:
   - Transfer boat into the heated SC-2 tank.
   - Dwell for **10 minutes** at **70 °C – 80 °C** to desorb ionic alkali (Na⁺, K⁺) and heavy metal contaminants (Fe, Cu, Ni).

7. **Final Cascade Rinse & Automated Marangoni Dry Execution**:
   - Transfer into the final cascade rinse tank until effluent resistivity recovers to **≥ 18.0 MΩ·cm**.
   - Robotically transfer the carrier into the Marangoni dry chamber.
   - Execute low-speed upward withdrawal through a saturated high-purity N₂/IPA vapor interface. The surface tension gradient (Marangoni effect) displaces the water film downwards into the liquid bulk, yielding zero watermark residue across active 180nm transistor channels ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) and high-aspect-ratio capacitor contacts.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 / SC-2 Bath Temperature** | **70 – 80** | **°C** | Inline calibrated PT100 thermocouple sensors |
| **DHF 50:1 Immersion Dwell Time** | **15 – 30** | **s** | Wet bench robotic PLC timer / recipe execution log |
| **QDR Rinse DI Water Resistivity** | **18.2** | **MΩ·cm** | Inline conductivity/resistivity cell at tank inlet |
| **Intermediate Rinse Cycle Duration** | **3** | **min** | Automated dump cycle counter / PLC dwell timer |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical formulation and operating conditions: SC-1 (5:1:1 DI:NH₄OH:H₂O₂ at 70°C–80°C for 10–15 min), 1:50 HF:H₂O dip for 15–30 s (hydrophilic to hydrophobic shift), SC-2 (6:1:1 DI:HCl:H₂O₂ at 70°C–80°C for 10 min), and 18.2 MΩ·cm DI water dump rinses (3 min).
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**
  - Personnel safety constraint: Hydrofluoric acid exposure mitigation requiring calcium gluconate gel on site.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Structural context: Protecting critical device dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) and high-density bitline/plug interfaces from particle and chemical watermark defects.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated sequential transfer across SC-1 (alkaline), dilute HF (acid/fluoride), and SC-2 (acidic oxidant) baths requires strict interlock control on robotic end-effector rinse cycles to prevent cross-bath chemical drag-out. Furthermore, the Marangoni drying stage demands tightly synchronized slow-pull motion profiles (0.5 to 1.5 mm/s) coupled with steady-state IPA/N2 vapor delivery; any micro-vibrations or abrupt velocity fluctuations in the z-axis servo will rupture the capillary meniscus and leave drying streaks or liquid droplet residues across 180nm DRAM active area patterns.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following the DHF oxide strip, the bare silicon surface is hydrogen-terminated and highly hydrophobic, making it extremely vulnerable to hydrocarbon adsorption and particle re-attachment during SC-2 immersion if the intermediate dump rinse cascade is insufficiently flushed. During the final Marangoni dry following SC-2 and UPW overflow rinse (resistivity > 18.2 MOhm-cm), precise surface tension gradient maintenance between DI water and IPA vapor is essential to strip water molecules cleanly without inducing premature regrowth of non-uniform chemical oxide (> 1.2 nm) before gate oxidation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade UPW with TOC below 5 ppb and 18.2 MOhm-cm resistivity is critical alongside SEMI Grade 5 (Ultra-pure) IPA, 37% HCl, 29% NH4OH, and 30% unstabilized H2O2. Sourcing ultra-pure carrier N2 (99.9999% purity, < 0.1 ppb moisture/oxygen) in the local supply chain for the Marangoni drying chamber must be locked down to prevent aerosol trace contamination and particle precipitation during high-volume wet bench runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sequential wet clean and dry cycle times (approx. 45-60 min total per lot) directly dictate frontend wafer line throughput ahead of thermal oxidation and implant steps. Robotic transfer arm failures or bath temperature drift (> +/- 2°C) trigger full lot aborts; dual-cassette throughput targets must be balanced against stringent bath life limits (maximum 6 hours for peroxide-based chemistries due to thermal decomposition).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Meniscus collapse during wafer lifting in Marangoni dry cycle causing water mark drying stains and localized localized gate dielectric breakdown defects
1. Chemical drag-out and cross-contamination between SC-1 and DHF/SC-2 tanks resulting in particulate precipitation and uncontrolled surface roughening
1. Peroxide depletion/decomposition in SC-1 or SC-2 causing heavy metal re-deposition and failure to strip organic/metallic contaminants prior to high-temperature processing

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-2-2-01` | **Post-Marangoni Water Mark and Particle Density Verification** | KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 / SP3 Laser Surface Particle Scanner | 1. Transfer post-clean/dry wafer cassette immediately from wet bench unloader to automated FOUP. 2. Load into KLA-Tencor Surfscan configured for 180nm defect sizing threshold. 3. Execute dark-field full-wafer scan with 3mm edge exclusion. 4. Map defect coordinates and classify light point defects (LPD) versus streak/water mark drying signatures. | `Total added particle count (delta) <= 10 particles at >= 0.18 um across 200mm wafer; 0 detectable drying marks, water spots, or meniscus collapse streaks.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-2-2-02` | **Post-SC-2 Surface Metallic Contamination and Chemical Oxide Uniformity** | Vapor Phase Decomposition Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (VPD-ICP-MS) and Spectroscopic Ellipsometer | 1. Measure chemical oxide thickness across 49-point polar map on post-dry wafer using Spectroscopic Ellipsometry. 2. Submit sample wafer to VPD chamber; scan surface using HF droplet decomposition. 3. Aspirate residue droplet and inject into ICP-MS to quantify Fe, Cu, Ni, Ca, and Na surface concentrations. | `Surface metallic concentration for Fe, Cu, Ni, Ca, Na <= 1.0E+10 atoms/cm2 each; native/chemical oxide thickness <= 1.0 nm with 1-sigma uniformity < 0.08 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Full chemical-splash face shield with ANSI Z87.1 approved impact safety glasses, Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene outer gloves over nitrile inner gloves, Acid/alkali-resistant chemical apron and sleeve protectors, Steel-toe chemical-resistant safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately rinse affected skin with copious flowing water for 2-3 minutes, then continuously massage 2.5% calcium gluconate gel into the burn site until medical personnel arrive. In case of eye contact, irrigate with sterile 1% calcium gluconate solution or normal saline for 15+ minutes. For SC-1/SC-2 acid/base splash: Flush skin/eyes under emergency shower/eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes. For IPA vapor inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated dual-exhaust infrastructure: segregated acid scrubbed exhaust for DHF/SC-2 tanks (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s at bath lip slots) and solvent/VOC exhaust for the Marangoni IPA dryer chamber with continuous optical lower explosive limit (LEL) monitoring interlocked to auto-purge N2 flow at 25% LEL.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated chemical drain lines: Acid/fluoride waste routed to Dedicated Fluoride Waste Treatment (precipitated with Ca(OH)2/CaCl2 as CaF2 sludge); RCA-1 alkaline waste and SC-2 acid waste routed to central Acid-Base Neutralization (AWN) system adjusting pH to 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal discharge; spent IPA routed to closed flammable solvent recovery drain.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 4 / VLSI | `0.5% - 1.0% (50:1 dilution)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)** | `7647-01-0` | SEMI Grade 5 / Ultra-Pure | `37%` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (NH4OH)** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI Grade 5 / Ultra-Pure | `29%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 5 / Unstabilized | `30%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 5 / Ultra-Pure Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic or post-etch contaminated silicon with native oxide, organic residues, and trace transition metals
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Particle-free, passivated ultra-thin chemical oxide (< 1.0 nm), completely dry and devoid of water marks or solvent residues
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption, volatile organic compound (VOC) condensation, and uncontrolled ambient native oxide growth causing gate dielectric leakage and threshold voltage shifts in 180nm DRAM access transistors

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Execution of automated sequential SC-1 / DHF 50:1 / SC-2 wet bench immersion and Marangoni drying delivers clean, surface-passivated, dry 200mm wafers meeting zero-water-mark and ultra-low defectivity standards required for 180nm DRAM gate oxidation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `rca_wet_bench_run_telemetry.csv`
- [ ] `marangoni_dry_particle_inspection_report.pdf`
- [ ] `vpd_icpms_metal_contamination_summary.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Added particle contamination count across 200mm wafer surface at >= 0.18 um** | `10` | <= +5 particles | KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP2 dark-field optical inspection with 3mm edge exclusion |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface transition metal concentration (Fe, Ni, Cu)** | `1.0E+10` | <= 1.0E+10 atoms/cm2 | Vapor Phase Decomposition Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (VPD-ICP-MS) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Final post-clean chemical oxide thickness** | `0.85` | +/- 0.15 nm | 49-point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry across 200mm wafer surface |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% automated recipe completion without robot transfer faults, verified final dump rinse bath resistivity >= 18.2 MOhm-cm, zero optical drying marks or meniscus collapse streaks, added particle count <= 10 at 0.18 um, and all metal trace concentrations <= 1.0E+10 atoms/cm2 verified by inline metrology sign-off.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Post-Clean Defect Metrology, Particle Density Inspection & Contact Angle Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Wet Sequence Execution > Sequential SC-1 / DHF 50:1 Strip / SC-2 Wet Clean & Marangoni Dry > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Post Marangoni Dry   │
│      Wafer Infeed      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Automated Surface    │
│  Particle Inspection   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ellipsometry Native   │
│     Oxide Mapping      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sessile Drop Contact  │
│    Angle Metrology     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Criteria Disposition  │
│       & Release        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Transfer & Alignment Setup**:
   - Transfer the wafer directly from the Marangoni dry exit cassette into the metrology loadlock/handling station under Class 1 mini-environment airflow.
   - Clamp substrate onto the precision motorized stage and verify Gen 2 stage optical alignment within **±5 µm** tolerance using microscope pattern recognition prior to inspection coordinates engagement.

2. **Laser Surface Particle Scanning & Density Metrology**:
   - Perform automated darkfield laser surface scanning across the full wafer active area (excluding a 3 mm edge exclusion zone).
   - Log localized scattering defects and map particle distribution to verify removal of organic and metallic residues post SC-1/SC-2 clean.

3. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Reflectometry Film Mapping**:
   - Position the wafer under the spectroscopic ellipsometer light beam across the UV-visible spectrum.
   - Execute an automated **9-point or 49-point wafer mapping** routine measuring polarization change parameters $\Psi$ and $\Delta$, where the complex reflection ratio is:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   - Apply Cauchy/Sellmeier optical dispersion models parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ to quantify residual chemical/native oxide thickness targeting the baseline regime with **$\pm0.05\text{ nm}$** measurement precision.

4. **Sessile Drop Contact Angle Verification**:
   - Dispense a calibrated sessile droplet of Ultra-Pure Deionized (DI) Water (1.0–2.0 µL) onto designated perimeter and center test dice.
   - Measure static contact angle using automated goniometric side-view optics:
     - Post-DHF strip hydrophobic validation confirms removal of hydrophilic native oxide and complete hydrogen passivation of the bare silicon surface.
     - Post-SC-2 / chemical re-oxidation hydrophilic state confirms complete wetting and absence of hydrophobic organic hydrocarbon contamination.

5. **Lot Disposition & Clean Line Feedback**:
   - Collate particle counts, residual oxide uniformity across the 9/49-point map, and contact angle data into the line SPC dashboard.
   - If acceptance limits are met, release wafer to downstream gate dielectric oxidation / furnace processing; if out-of-spec, trigger re-clean cycle.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Stage / Align Marks (Gen 2 standard) |
| **Ellipsometry Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi$, $\Delta$ dispersion) |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity Mapping** | $9\text{ or }49$ | $\text{points / wafer}$ | Automated Radial Polarized Reflectometry Grid |
| **Film Thickness Measurement Precision** | $\pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Reflectometry / Ellipsometry |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**:
  - Measurement principle based on Fresnel reflection ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ and Cauchy/Sellmeier parameterization of $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Sub-Angstrom precision requirement ($\pm0.05\text{ nm}$) on thin oxide films and reflectometry precision within $\pm2\text{ nm}$.
  - Wafer mapping protocol utilizing automated 9-point or 49-point grid to track radial film non-uniformity.
- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**:
  - Gen 2 alignment tolerance limit established at $\pm5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.
  - DI water rinse and surface cleanliness requirements preceding high-resolution lithography.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Transistor gate channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) requiring strict gate oxide interface cleanliness to prevent sub-threshold leakage exceeding $1\text{ fA/cell}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-clean metrology for 180nm DRAM integration must establish a deterministic quality baseline prior to gate oxidation and initial dielectric stack deposition. The metrology loop cannot rely on destructive physical sampling. Optical darkfield scattering for defect detection paired with goniometric sessile drop contact angle measurements provides a rapid, high-throughput verification gate, but optical scattering inspection limits sensitivity on bare silicon without calibrated reference haze standards, risking unflagged micro-particulate bridging at the Gen 1 mm scale.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following the full sequential SC-1 / DHF 50:1 / SC-2 clean and Marangoni dry, the wafer surface terminates in a chemical oxide that should be uniformly hydrophilic (contact angle < 10° for standard RCA-2 passivated surface, or > 75° if DHF-last is selected). If the process specifies complete SC-2 termination, water contact angle must reflect silanol-rich (Si-OH) passivation. Any localized contact angle variation (> 5° standard deviation across a 9-point radial map) indicates non-uniform rinse drying, Marangoni surfactant residue, or airborne organic condensation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Dedicated laser surface particle counters (e.g., KLA-Tencor Surfscan) are prohibitively capital-intensive for Gen 1 open-source fabs. We must baseline our particle density protocol on high-resolution motorized darkfield optical microscopy with stitching software and image thresholding (ImageJ/Fiji pipeline) combined with a benchtop optical goniometer using calibrated HPLC-grade DI water micro-syringes to ensure reproducible results with low capital expense.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology execution directly impacts process queue time (Q-time). If post-clean inspection consumes more than 20 minutes in ambient fab air, organic contamination and uncontrolled native oxide growth will invalidate the surface passivation state before thermal oxidation or LPCVD furnace loading. Metrology must be strictly time-boxed and conducted in an ISO Class 5 laminar flow hood within the cleanroom bay.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Secondary airborne particle deposition during goniometric droplet testing due to stagnant cleanroom airflow or operator proximity.
1. Organic cross-contamination of DI water droplet tip causing false high contact angle readings on hydrophilic chemical oxide surfaces.
1. Particle classification error caused by micro-bubble dry spots or Marangoni drying stain halos misidentified as solid particulate defects.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-2-3-01` | **Post-Marangoni Surface Particle Density and Defect Inspection** | Automated Darkfield Optical Metallurgical Microscope (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25, 48MP CMOS sensor) with motorized XY stage and digital image thresholding analyzer | 1. Mount 100mm silicon wafer onto microscope vacuum stage. 2. Calibrate optical darkfield illumination against a certified 0.5 um particle calibration grid. 3. Execute automated 9-point radial raster scan across wafer diameter (center, +/- 20mm, +/- 35mm, +/- 45mm, excluding 3mm edge exclusion zone). 4. Capture darkfield scattering micrographs at each point covering 2.5 mm^2 per field of view. 5. Process raw images through automated contrast thresholding filter to extract particle count and size distribution (> 1.0 um equivalent spherical diameter). | `Total defect/particle density across the inspected area must be <= 0.15 particles/cm^2 for particles >= 1.0 um; zero localized clusters (> 3 particles within 50 um radius); pass status logged to metrology database.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-2-3-02` | **Post-SC-2 Chemical Oxide Contact Angle and Surface Energy Verification** | Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with calibrated 2.0 uL dispensing micro-syringe and telecentric high-speed digital video camera | 1. Position wafer on non-contact kinematic goniometer stage. 2. Dispense a precise 2.0 uL droplet of ultra-pure DI water using a PTFE-coated needle via automated sessile drop dispensing. 3. Lower stage until droplet contacts wafer surface and cleanly detaches from needle without mechanical vibration. 4. Record droplet profile at 60 fps for 5 seconds. 5. Fit droplet silhouette using Young-Laplace baseline fitting algorithm at 1.0 second post-deposition. 6. Repeat at 5 mapped wafer locations (center, north, south, east, west at r = 35mm). | `Mean contact angle must be < 8.0 degrees for hydrophilic SC-2 chemical oxide termination, with radial standard deviation <= 1.5 degrees across all 5 test points. No droplet pinning asymmetry (> 2.0 degrees delta between left and right contact angles).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 compatible powder-free nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with UV side shields, Lint-free antistatic cleanroom gown, hood, and boot covers, Cleanroom ESD face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye exposure to ultra-pure DI water: No physiological hazard; if mechanical eye irritation occurs from micro-droplet impact, flush with isotonic eye wash for 5 minutes. For IPA exposure: Flush affected eyes with clean water for 15 minutes; for inhalation of IPA vapors, move victim to fresh air. If irritation persists, seek medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operate within ISO Class 5 laminar flow hood equipped with ULPA/HEPA filtration (minimum face velocity 0.45 m/s +/- 20%). Metrology station must have passive exhaust for trace IPA calibration solvent vapors.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent DI water droplets and wiping tissues are non-hazardous; collect in dedicated cleanroom solid waste receptacles. IPA wipes must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-resistant solvent waste cans for hazardous chemical incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (Ultra-Pure)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade Type E-1 (Resistivity >= 18.2 MOhm-cm at 25°C) | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Goniometer Calibration & Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed (>18.2 MOhm-cm DI water) and Marangoni-dried bare silicon with thin, protective SC-2 chemical oxide (passivated Si-OH terminations, dry and particulate-free).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, defect-verified hydrophilic silicon wafer with certified particle density <= 0.15 particles/cm^2 and contact angle < 8.0°, packaged in sealed ultra-clean polycarbonate FOUP/SMIF pod under dry N2 purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air queue time causes airborne molecular organic contamination (volatile organic carbon adsorption) and uncontrolled native oxide growth, shifting contact angle > 15° and causing dielectric breakdown defects in subsequent gate oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete metrological validation confirming cleanroom particle density specifications and uniform hydrophilic chemical oxide surface energy across 100mm silicon wafers post-RCA sequence. Validated wafer lots meet criteria for transfer to the gate oxidation furnace line.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `post_clean_particle_density_map.csv`
- [ ] `contact_angle_sessile_analysis_report.pdf`
- [ ] `stitched_darkfield_surface_inspection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-clean total surface particle density for defects >= 1.0 um across inspected wafer area** | `0.10 particles/cm^2` | <= 0.15 particles/cm^2 | Automated darkfield optical microscopy 9-point raster image segmentation analysis |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Sessile drop static DI water contact angle on post-SC-2 chemical oxide surface** | `5.5 deg` | <= 8.0 deg (radial standard deviation <= 1.5 deg) | Young-Laplace profile fitting on 5-point optical goniometer measurements |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Metrology loop execution latency from Marangoni dry exit to N2 pod staging** | `12.0 min` | <= 20.0 min | Cleanroom MES batch timestamp log tracking |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions validated on 100% of batch sample wafers, zero particle clusters > 1.0 um detected, mean contact angle strictly < 8.0°, and formal signoff generated in metrology MES before N2 cassette transfer to gate dielectric module.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-RCA-180NM-01
**Title:** Surface Particle & Native Oxide Ellipsometric/TXRF Metrology Inspection  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Wet Sequence Execution > Surface Particle & Native Oxide Ellipsometric/TXRF Metrology Inspection  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Equipment & Pre-Requisites
- **Metrology Systems:**
  - Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (polarized light source, automated motorized stage, Cauchy / Sellmeier dispersion modeling software).
  - Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Spectrometer / Laser Surface Particle Scanner.
- **Substrates:** 180nm DRAM wafers immediately post-RCA clean (RCA-1 $\rightarrow$ DHF native oxide strip $\rightarrow$ RCA-2 cascade dump rinse and spin-dry).
- **Environment:** ISO Class 3 (Class 1) or Class 4 mini-environment with HEPA filtration.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Wafer Loading & Vacuum Chuck Alignment          |
+----------------------------------------------------+
                          |
                          v
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Automated Multi-Point Ellipsometric Mapping     |
|    - 9-point or 49-point pattern                   |
|    - Measure Psi & Delta via Fresnel reflection   |
+----------------------------------------------------+
                          |
                          v
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Optical Modeling & Film Thickness Extraction    |
|    - Parameterize n(lambda), k(lambda) via Cauchy  |
|    - Verify sub-Angstrom precision (±0.05 nm)      |
+----------------------------------------------------+
                          |
                          v
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 4. TXRF & Surface Particle Inspection              |
|    - Check metallic trace limits & particle defects|
+----------------------------------------------------+
                          |
                          v
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 5. Disposition & Cassette Unload                   |
+----------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Wafer Loading and Alignment
1. Transfer post-RCA cleaned and dried wafers in sealed, ultra-clean FOUP/cassettes to the metrology load port.
2. Load wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the Spectroscopic Ellipsometer.
3. Perform optical notch/flat recognition and automated chuck leveling to establish coordinate origin $(X_0, Y_0)$.

#### Step 2: Multi-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Mapping
1. Initialize the automated wafer mapping routine: select either the standardized **9-point** or **49-point** radial pattern across the wafer diameter to assess cross-wafer non-uniformity.
2. Illuminate measurement sites with polarized incident light across the designated spectral wavelength range $\lambda$.
3. Measure the change in polarization upon reflection from the wafer surface, acquiring amplitude ratio $\Psi$ and phase difference $\Delta$ defined by:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   *(where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients).*

#### Step 3: Optical Dispersion Modeling & Thickness Extraction
1. Load the pre-calibrated optical stack model (`Si substrate / native chemical SiO2 / ambient`).
2. Parameterize refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ using the **Cauchy** or **Sellmeier** dispersion model.
3. Fit the measured $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra to extract native/chemical oxide thickness with sub-Angstrom precision target of $\pm0.05\text{ nm}$.
4. Compute mean thickness, standard deviation ($1\sigma$), and radial non-uniformity percentage across the mapped points.

#### Step 4: TXRF and Particle Verification
1. Transfer wafer to the surface inspection module / TXRF chamber.
2. Perform total reflection X-ray fluorescence excitation at glancing angle below critical angle $\theta_c$ to detect trace metal surface contamination (Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn).
3. Scan laser scattering channels to register surface particle count and spatial coordinate distribution post-megasonic clean.

#### Step 5: Lot Disposition
1. Compare ellipsometric thickness, radial non-uniformity, and defect density against established acceptance criteria.
2. If metrics pass, release the lot for gate oxidation / stacked capacitor dielectric formation (effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$). If failing, flag for rework or cleaning line abort.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method / Tool | Action Limit / Trigger |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ellipsometric Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Cauchy/Sellmeier model) | Recalibrate optical light path if residual $\chi^2 > 1.5$ |
| **Measurement Mapping Grid** | $9\text{-point}$ or $49\text{-point}$ mapped pattern | Automated Motorized Chuck Program | Abort if edge exclusion $< 3\text{ mm}$ triggers fault |
| **Megasonic Cleaning Rinse Quality** | $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water resistivity | In-line Cascade Dump Rinse Resistivity Sensor | Hold lot if resistivity $\le 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Target Compatibility** | $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (ensuring refresh interval target) | Automated Parametric / Cell Leakage Tester | Reject wafer lot if junction leakage $\ge 1\text{ fA/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Context References & Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Polarization change formulation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$; Cauchy and Sellmeier optical dispersion parameterization of $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$; measurement precision specification of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Angstrom level); automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping protocols.
- **RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**: Post-RCA cascade dump rinse requirements ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW rinsing until bath resistivity $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$); standard SC-1 megasonic agitation at $1\text{ MHz}$; hydrophobic dewetting transitions.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: 180nm integration targets including access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor dielectric stack requirements ($\kappa > 15$, $C \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$), and cell leakage ceiling ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-RCA cleaning inspection requires seamless coupling between wet-bench dump rinser/spin-rinse-dry (SRD) transfer robots and metrology pods. A major system risk is the optical spot size (>25 um) averaging across micro-roughness or patterned kerf test areas, obscuring local native oxide regrowth kinetics. Furthermore, unpurged spectroscopic ellipsometer load locks permit ambient room air ingress, accelerating native oxide growth by up to 0.15 nm within the first 10 minutes and invalidating baseline gate-oxide growth kinetics.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical modeling of ultra-thin chemical/native oxide (<1.5 nm) via Cauchy dispersion is ill-conditioned due to high parameter correlation between thickness d and refractive index n. A fixed-index model (n = 1.46 at 632.8 nm) or an advanced Cody-Lorentz parameterization must be enforced on bare silicon to decouple substrate optical constants (eps1, eps2) from overlayer thickness. Simultaneously, TXRF grazing angle calibration must be aligned strictly below the critical angle (theta_c ~ 0.18 deg for Mo-Kalpha on Si) to prevent bulk substrate scattering and guarantee sub-1E10 atoms/cm2 detection limits for trace transition metals (Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Dedicated TXRF calibration reference wafers (micro-droplet or spin-coat standards for Fe, Ni, Cu at 1E11 atoms/cm2) have lead times exceeding 16 weeks and degrade from particulate accumulation if stored outside Class 1 FOUPs. Silicon calibration mirrors and spectroscopic ellipsometer reference SiO2 thermal wafers (e.g., NIST-traceable 2.0 nm and 100.0 nm standards) require periodic certification and nitrogen dry-box preservation to prevent calibration drift under humid Southeast Asian tropical ambient conditions.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput is the critical bottleneck: full 49-point wafer ellipsometry mapping plus a 5-point TXRF integration run takes ~22 minutes per wafer, threatening the 30-minute queue-time constraint for gate oxide furnace entry. The process flow must decouple pilot monitoring (1 wafer/lot at 9-point ellipsometry + central TXRF) from engineering qualification to prevent lot stalling and costly chemical re-cleans.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Queue-time expiry (>30 minutes in cleanroom air) inducing uncontrolled ambient native oxide regrowth (>0.3 nm) and airborne organic contamination, shifting target threshold voltages in 180nm DRAM access transistors.
1. TXRF grazing angle misalignment exceeding critical angle theta_c, yielding catastrophic background noise, loss of surface sensitivity, and undetected mobile/heavy metal contamination (Fe > 5E10 atoms/cm2) causing DRAM junction leakage.
1. Misparameterization of thin oxide refractive index in ellipsometric regression, causing systematic underestimation of oxide thickness and subsequent gate dielectric breakdown.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-3-01` | **Automated 49-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Native Oxide Thickness & Uniformity Verification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Rotating Compensator, 190-850 nm, Spot Size <= 30 um) calibrated with NIST-traceable 2.0 nm SiO2/Si standard | 1. Verify optical calibration using NIST-traceable 100 nm and 2.0 nm SiO2 reference wafers (MSE < 1.5). 2. Align 150mm/200mm p-type test wafer notch/flat and auto-focus laser z-height at center die. 3. Execute automated 49-point polar mapping across the wafer with a 3 mm edge exclusion. 4. Acquire Psi and Delta spectra over 250-800 nm at 70-degree angle of incidence. 5. Perform Levenberg-Marquardt regression fitting to extract film thickness across all 49 points. 6. Compute mean thickness, standard deviation (1-sigma), and percent non-uniformity [(max - min) / (2 * mean) * 100]. | `Mean chemical/native oxide thickness <= 0.85 nm (target 0.60 nm); 1-sigma thickness non-uniformity across 49 points <= 0.05 nm (<= 5.0%); fitting Goodness of Fit (MSE) < 2.0.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-3-02` | **TXRF Trace Surface Metallic Contamination and Critical Angle Metrology** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Spectrometer with Mo-Kalpha X-ray tube (50 kV, 40 mA), W/C multilayer monochromator, and Si(Li) or SDD detector | 1. Load TXRF multi-element calibration wafer (Fe, Ni, Cu @ 1.0E11 atoms/cm2); confirm elemental sensitivity factors. 2. Load RCA-cleaned wafer and perform automated reflectivity scan (angle sweep from 0.05 to 0.30 degrees in 0.01-degree steps) to locate critical angle theta_c (0.18 degrees for Si substrate). 3. Set measurement incident angle to 0.13 degrees (70% of theta_c). 4. Perform 5-point measurement (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right at 10 mm edge exclusion) with live acquisition time of 500 seconds per point under vacuum. 5. Integrate fluorescent peak intensities for Fe, Ni, Cu, and Zn; quantify areal density using validated instrumental response factors. | `Surface concentrations across all 5 points: Iron (Fe) < 1.0E10 atoms/cm2, Nickel (Ni) < 5.0E9 atoms/cm2, Copper (Cu) < 5.0E9 atoms/cm2, and Zinc (Zn) < 1.0E10 atoms/cm2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol), Polycarbonate laser safety glasses (OD 5+ for 632.8 nm and UV wavelengths 190-400 nm), Personal radiation dosimeter badge (thermoluminescent or electronic dosimeter), Standard Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit, hood, boots, and face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For X-ray radiation interlock trip or suspected exposure: Immediately engage Emergency Machine Off (EMO), evacuate enclosure, notify Radiation Safety Officer (RSO), and report for medical examination with dosimeter readout. For IPA contact or splash: Flush skin/eyes with copious running water for >= 15 minutes at cleanroom eyewash station; for inhalation of solvent fumes, relocate victim to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Metrology chamber exhaust connected to dedicated cleanroom general solvent exhaust (minimum duct face velocity 0.5 m/s); vacuum pump oil-free scroll exhaust vented to exterior scrubber line; X-ray generator enclosed in lead-lined safety interlocked housing (radiation leakage < 0.5 uSv/h at 5 cm distance from exterior panels).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA lint-free cleaning wipes must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-proof hazardous solvent waste bins and disposed of per hazardous solvent protocols; metrology produces no direct aqueous acid effluent.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) - Metrology Stage Cleaning** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI-C12 / VLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Chamber & Stage Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, clean chemical oxide terminated surface immediately following RCA-1 / DHF / RCA-2 and spin-rinse dry, particle-free, with zero visible water marks or haze.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-cleared, characterized wafer with confirmed chemical oxide thickness <= 0.85 nm and trace metal contamination < 1E10 atoms/cm2, staged in purged carrier ready for gate oxidation or sacrificial oxide growth.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time causes uncontrolled native oxide thickening (>1.2 nm) via room ambient moisture/oxygen uptake and airborne volatile organic compound (VOC) adsorption, causing gate oxide dielectric breakdown, interface state trap density spikes (Dit > 1E11 eV-1 cm-2), and DRAM bitline contact resistance degradation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful spectroscopic ellipsometric and TXRF verification of post-RCA wafer surface, certifying native/chemical oxide thickness <= 0.85 nm with < 5% non-uniformity and critical transition metal levels (Fe, Cu, Ni) below 1.0E10 atoms/cm2, guaranteeing cleanroom gate dielectric readiness.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `49pt_ellipsometry_native_oxide_thickness_map.csv`
- [ ] `txrf_trace_metal_areal_density_report.pdf`
- [ ] `polar_surface_oxide_uniformity_contour.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean chemical/native oxide thickness measured across 49 wafer points** | `0.60 nm` | +/- 0.25 nm | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry 49-point polar scan with fixed index SiO2 model (n=1.460) and Levenberg-Marquardt regression (MSE < 2.0) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface transition metal contamination density for Iron (Fe) and Copper (Cu)** | `< 1.0E10 atoms/cm2` | + 0.0E0 atoms/cm2 (Hard Upper Limit) | TXRF 5-point measurement at incident angle 0.13 deg (70% theta_c), calibrated against certified 1E11 atoms/cm2 standard |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Radial oxide thickness 1-sigma non-uniformity across 150mm/200mm wafer (3mm edge exclusion)** | `<= 5.0%` | +/- 0.5% | Statistical calculation from 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry data array |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 49-point ellipsometry mean thickness <= 0.85 nm, 1-sigma non-uniformity <= 5.0%, and TXRF surface Fe/Cu/Ni concentrations strictly < 1.0E10 atoms/cm2 confirmed within 30-minute air queue time, accompanied by automated QA signoff and digital export of .csv and .pdf metrology logs to the MES lot tracking system.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Calibration & Optical Model Recipe Setup

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Wet Sequence Execution > Surface Particle & Native Oxide Ellipsometric/TXRF Metrology Inspection > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Calibration & Optical Model Recipe Setup  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   System Baseline &   │
│       Hardware        │
│    Initialization     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Standard Reference   │
│    Calibration: Si    │
│  substrate & Native   │
│         Oxide         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Optical Dispersion   │
│   Model Selection:    │
│  Cauchy / Sellmeier   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Target Film Recipe   │
│   Parameterization    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Multi-Point      │
│    Automated Wafer    │
│  Mapping: 9-point or  │
│       49-point        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Goodness-of-Fit &   │
│       Tolerance       │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **System Baseline & Hardware Initialization**:
   - Power up the spectroscopic ellipsometer light source (xenon or UV-visible broadband source). Allow a minimum 30-minute warm-up for lamp spectral stability.
   - Verify optical beam alignment, polarizer, compensator, and analyzer angles using the integrated self-test routine.

2. **Standard Reference Calibration (Straight-Through & Calibration Wafer)**:
   - Perform a straight-through (no-sample) calibration or load a certified calibration standard (e.g., bare Si substrate with known thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ film).
   - Acquire amplitude ratio ($\Psi$) and phase change ($\Delta$) raw spectra across the target spectral range.
   - Confirm baseline signal-to-noise ratio and detector linearity.

3. **Optical Model Definition & Recipe Selection**:
   - Define sample stack: Substrate layer (Silicon) + Interfacial/Native Oxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) + Dielectric/Target film.
   - Assign dispersion relationships to parameterize the refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$:
     - **Dielectrics (Oxide/Nitride)**: Apply the **Cauchy** or **Sellmeier** dispersion model.
     - **Photoresist Layer**: Select Cauchy dispersion parameterized for resist formulations (e.g., Shipley 1813).
   - Set the fundamental ellipsometric equation solver:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are complex Fresnel reflection coefficients.

4. **Measurement Recipe Parameterization**:
   - Configure angle of incidence (AOI) to near Brewster's angle for silicon (typically $70^\circ$ or $75^\circ$) to maximize sensitivity.
   - Set recipe acquisition bounds: Gate oxide mode (target $\approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) or Photoresist mode (target $\approx 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Configure automated stage coordinates for either a **9-point** or **49-point** automated wafer mapping pattern to track radial film non-uniformity across spin coating or furnace thermal processing.

5. **Sample Execution & Regression Fitting**:
   - Vacuum-chuck the post-RCA cleaned/processed wafer onto the motorized sample stage.
   - Execute the selected mapping recipe. Regress experimental $(\Psi, \Delta)$ curves against calculated model parameters to extract layer thickness $d$, $n(\lambda)$, and Mean Squared Error (MSE / goodness-of-fit).
   - Flag out-of-spec measurement points and inspect residual plots for non-uniformity or interfacial roughness anomalies.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Physical Tolerance | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thin Gate Oxide Measurement Precision** | $3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Ångström precision) | Static 10-run repeatability test on calibrated dry oxide standard |
| **Thick Film / Photoresist Thickness Accuracy** | $1.3\ \mu\text{m} \pm 2\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic regression fit on spun resist (e.g., Shipley 1813) |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Density** | **9-point** or **49-point** automated radial array | Automated stage map coordinate execution report |
| **Gen 2 Stage Alignment Tolerance** | $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ | Motorized stage positioning feedback against optical fiducials |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Source: Ellipsometry Basics**:
  - Principles of measuring differential phase change $\Delta$ and amplitude ratio $\Psi$.
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Non-destructive monitoring for oxide, nitride, and photoresist thickness.
  - Governing physical equation: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$ using complex Fresnel reflection coefficients.
  - Dispersion modeling via **Cauchy** and **Sellmeier** formulations for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Precision bounds: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measured to $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$; photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) measured to $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
  - Wafer mapping automation: Standard **9-point** or **49-point** patterns tracking radial non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
- **Source: Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - Resist layer benchmark: Shipley 1813 spun at 4000 RPM giving $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thickness.
  - Alignment tolerance progression: Gen 2 stage precision specified at $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Optical metrology integration must maintain end-to-end data traceability across the wafer clean bay, ensuring coordinate alignment between TXRF inspection stages and ellipsometer multi-point chuck mapping. Systemic drift in goniometer tilt (±0.01 deg) or Xenon light-source spectral intensity must be compensated in real-time to avoid pseudo-thickness variance cascades downstream.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Fitting sub-2 nm native oxides or post-RCA thermal oxides requires a fixed refractive index parameterization (n = 1.457 at 632.8 nm) rather than floating both thickness and dispersion coefficients simultaneously. Attempting to fit Cauchy parameters (A_n, B_n) alongside thickness below 5 nm creates strong mathematical cross-correlation in the (Psi, Delta) phase-space inversion, producing non-physical oxide solutions.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Certified reference standard wafers (NIST-traceable 100 nm thermal SiO2 on Si and native oxide bare silicon verification coupons) require calibrated re-certification cycles every 12 months. Dual-sourcing calibrated optical standard sets from VLSI Standards or equivalent metrology vendors is necessary to avoid single-point calibration lockouts during pilot production.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Routine calibration verification must be constrained to a 5-minute overhead window at shift startup to maintain overall RCA bench throughput. High-density 49-point wafer mapping recipes must be reserved for process qualification lots, while running a rapid 9-point radial map for inline production release to prevent queue time bottlenecks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Cross-correlation parameter divergence in Cauchy dispersion fitting yielding negative or non-physical oxide thickness values for films thinner than 3.0 nm.
1. Angle-of-incidence (AOI) mechanical drift exceeding 0.05 degrees on the rotating analyzer/polarizer arm, inducing systematic systematic thickness measurement offsets > 0.3 nm across all lots.
1. Organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption onto the NIST reference wafer surface, falsely drifting baseline calibration targets by +0.2 to +0.5 nm.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-3-1-01` | **NIST-Traceable Standard Calibration Verification & Goniometer Alignment Check** | Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE, 240 nm - 1000 nm spectral range, rotating compensator optical architecture) | 1. Load NIST calibration standard wafer onto vacuum chuck and initiate automatic vacuum hold (>= -80 kPa). 2. Execute optical beam center and tilt alignment at 70.00 deg angle of incidence using the quadrant photodiode detector. 3. Acquire spectroscopic (Psi, Delta) spectra across 250 nm to 850 nm at 70.00 deg AOI. 4. Run baseline calibration regression against the standard calibration library model. 5. Record extracted film thickness, mean squared error (MSE), and goniometer offset. | `Measured SiO2 film thickness must be within 100.00 ± 0.15 nm of the NIST certificate value; Goodness-of-Fit Mean Squared Error (MSE) <= 1.50; beam tilt alignment deviation < 0.02 deg.` |

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 49-Point Wafer Native Oxide Thickness & Refractive Index Mapping

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Load Wafer & Align  │
│        Notch         │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│    Spectroscopic     │
│     Calibration      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│    Execute 49-Pt     │
│   Polarimetric Map   │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│    Fresnel/Cauchy    │
│  Dispersion Fitting  │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│      Acceptance      │
│    Verification &    │
│      Pass/Fail       │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Purpose
This procedure defines the non-destructive spectroscopic ellipsometry metrology protocol to map wafer-scale native oxide thickness ($t_{ox}$) and refractive index ($n$) across 49 polar/Cartesian sampling sites following the standard RCA-1 / DHF oxide strip / RCA-2 wet clean sequence.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System Initialization & Reference Calibration**:
   - Verify optical metrology chamber environment ($21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, relative humidity $< 45\%$).
   - Load clean reference calibration standard wafer (bare Si standard with known oxide thickness).
   - Calibrate the rotating analyzer/polarizer optics across the UV-visible spectrum ($\lambda = 250\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$) to zero baseline phase offset.

2. **Wafer Loading & Pre-Alignment**:
   - Transfer the post-clean 200mm wafer onto the vacuum chuck via automated end-effector.
   - Engage vacuum chucking and run optical notch/flat pre-alignment to establish the wafer coordinate origin $(0, 0)$ at the center of the wafer.

3. **Recipe Selection & Model Definition**:
   - Load the standard `49PT_NATIVE_OXIDE_MAP` polar/Cartesian coordinate recipe.
   - Configure optical model parameters:
     - Substrate: Single-crystal Silicon ($\text{c-Si}$).
     - Ambient: Air ($n = 1.000$).
     - Overlayer: Native Silicon Dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) parameterized by the Cauchy dispersion model $n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2}$ with extinction coefficient $k(\lambda) = 0$.

4. **Polarimetric 49-Point Acquisition**:
   - Set incidence angle $\Phi = 70.0^\circ$ (Brewster angle regime for $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$ interface sensitivity).
   - Systematically step the wafer stage across all 49 radial and azimuthal coordinates.
   - At each site, measure the polarization amplitude ratio ($\Psi$) and phase difference ($\Delta$) according to the fundamental Fresnel reflectance ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$

5. **Dispersion Fitting & Wafer Map Generation**:
   - Execute non-linear regression (Levenberg-Marquardt) fitting to determine $t_{ox}$ and $n$ per coordinate.
   - Generate full-wafer contour maps displaying radial film uniformity, center-to-edge profile, and total thickness variation across the 49 points.

6. **Post-Inspection Unload**:
   - Verify mean thickness, standard deviation ($1\sigma$), and goodness-of-fit (MSE).
   - Release vacuum chuck and transfer wafer to FOUP/carrier for gate dielectric furnace processing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Precision | Context Citation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Precision (Dry Oxide / Thin Oxide Regime)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal baseline | Sub-Angstrom precision: $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ | *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Grid Mapping Point Density** | Automated grid array | Exactly $49\text{ points}$ | *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Dispersion Parameterization Model** | Optical fitting model | Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion [$n(\lambda)$, $k(\lambda)$] | *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Gate Dielectric Baseline Target (Post-Oxidation Reference)** | $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation | Physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Principles: Polarization ratio $\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Optical modeling via Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Precision: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
  - Grid inspection: Automated 49-point wafer mapping for radial film non-uniformity tracking.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation target physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated 49-point polar coordinate spectroscopic ellipsometry mapping must integrate directly into the fab CIM/MES execution layer via SECS/GEM (GEM300/E39) to eliminate manual recipe execution errors. The optical modeling engine must decouple parameter correlation between film thickness (t_ox) and refractive index (n) for ultra-thin sub-2.0 nm native oxides by fixing the Sellmeier dispersion parameters of the crystalline silicon substrate and utilizing a parameterized Cauchy model (A_n = 1.465, B_n = 0.004 um^2, k = 0) with multi-angle measurements (e.g., 65°, 70°, 75°) to prevent unphysical optical parameter divergence.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Directly post DHF oxide strip and RCA-2 clean, native oxide re-growth on hydrogen-terminated Si(100) proceeds logarithmically under ambient cleanroom air (driven by moisture and trace O2). A 49-point map requires precise stage settling time and rapid spot-rastering (<90 seconds total scan time) to avoid intra-wafer systematic gradient artifacts where point 49 reads artificially thicker than point 1 due to ambient oxidation during the scan. Furthermore, edge exclusion must be strictly set to >=3 mm to eliminate edge-bead and bevel bevel-reflection depolarization effects.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-wavelength ellipsometers lack the spectral fidelity needed for sub-Angstrom native oxide resolution; spectroscopic ellipsometer systems (e.g., Woollam M-2000 or KLA Aleris equivalent) require calibrated Deuterium/Quartz-Tungsten-Halogen (D2/QTH) dual lamps with typical MTBF of 2000 hours. Sourcing certified silicon reference calibration standards (certified 2.0 nm and 100.0 nm SiO2 thermally grown on Si) with valid NIST-traceable calibration certs is on a 6-to-8 week lead time and critical for daily tool qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology overhead must not bottleneck the wet bench throughput: 49-point wafer mapping must maintain a cycle time of <=120 seconds per wafer including robotic load/unload. If the metrology queue exceeds 30 minutes in cleanroom ambient air following DHF/RCA-2 clean, native oxide exceeds the 0.8 nm gate threshold and forces a non-conformance wafer scrap/re-clean cycle, severely degrading line yield.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thickness-refractive index parameter cross-correlation artifact leading to unphysical n values (e.g., n > 1.65 or n < 1.35) while masking true interfacial chemical oxide thickness.
1. Ambient oxidation gradient induced during lengthy stage mapping, corrupting the radial uniformity (1-sigma > 5%) metric.
1. Misalignment of optical beam focal plane due to wafer bow/warp (>30 um) causing signal depolarization and fit goodness (MSE) exceeding threshold.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-3-2-01` | **49-Point Polar Polarimetric Native Oxide Thickness and Uniformity Verification** | Automated Multi-Wavelength Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (245-1000 nm, 70 deg incident angle, automated motorized r-theta stage, beam spot diameter <= 100 um) | 1. Load wafer onto vacuum chuck with flat/notch alignment at 0 degrees. 2. Execute automated 49-point concentric ring polar map recipe with 3 mm edge exclusion (Center: 1 pt; Ring 1 (r=0.25R): 8 pts; Ring 2 (r=0.50R): 12 pts; Ring 3 (r=0.75R): 16 pts; Ring 4 (r=0.95R): 12 pts). 3. Collect polarization ratio rho = tan(Psi) * exp(i * Delta) across 245-1000 nm spectrum at each site. 4. Fit measured spectra to a two-layer model (Si Substrate / Native SiO2 with Cauchy dispersion n(lambda)=A + B/lambda^2, A=1.465, B=0.004 um^2, k=0). 5. Extract thickness (t_ox) and Mean Squared Error (MSE) per point; compute wafer mean thickness and 1-sigma percent standard deviation. | `Wafer Mean Thickness: 0.5 nm <= t_ox <= 1.2 nm; Radial Uniformity: 1-sigma <= 4.0%; Optical Fit Goodness: MSE <= 2.5 across all 49 measurement sites.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-3-2-02` | **Refractive Index Stability and Multi-Angle Dispersion Validation** | Variable Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE) equipped with multi-angle goniometer (65 deg, 70 deg, 75 deg) and micro-spot optics | 1. Position measurement beam at center site (Point 1) and 4 cardinal peripheral sites (Points 13, 25, 37, 49). 2. Acquire spectroscopic Psi and Delta profiles at three distinct angles of incidence: 65.0 deg, 70.0 deg, and 75.0 deg. 3. Perform coupled optical regression letting thickness and refractive index parameter A_n float simultaneously. 4. Verify that residual correlation coefficient between thickness and refractive index does not exceed |0.90|. 5. Extract refractive index value evaluated at standard HeNe laser wavelength (lambda = 632.8 nm). | `Refractive Index at 632.8 nm: 1.450 <= n <= 1.470; Correlation Coefficient: |Corr(t, n)| < 0.90; Residual Fit Goodness: MSE <= 2.0.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom clean vinyl/nitrile gloves with double-gloving protocol, UV-filtering laser safety glasses rated for Class 1/Class 2 laser positioning diodes (ANSI Z136.1 compliant), Static-dissipative cleanroom gown, hood, ESD footwear, and face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For nitrogen asphyxiation hazard from line rupture: Immediately evacuate personnel to fresh air, activate emergency oxygen supply, and perform CPR if breathing has ceased. For IPA eye/skin contact: Irrigate exposed eyes with copious clean water for >=15 minutes at cleanroom emergency eye-wash station; remove contaminated clothing and wash skin thoroughly with soap and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool ambient enclosure maintained under ISO Class 4 laminar HEPA/ULPA downflow (0.45 m/s +/- 20%); internal stage mini-environment vented via dedicated general cleanroom exhaust (min 50 CFM) to prevent nitrogen build-up or ozone accumulation generated by short-wavelength D2 UV lamps.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: No hazardous liquid effluent generated during optical metrology. IPA cleaning wipes must be disposed of in dedicated airtight hazardous flammables disposal bins lined with anti-static bags and processed according to SEMI S2 cleanroom waste guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (Purge and Chuck Float)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100.0%` |
| **Silicon Dioxide (Native Surface Oxide Matrix on Silicon)** | `7631-86-9` | Semiconductor Surface Film | `Solid Monolayer Film` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Optics and Chuck Wipe)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C12 / VLSI) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic to weakly hydrophilic hydrogen/fluorine-terminated silicon surface immediately following dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF 1:50) strip and ultra-pure water (UPW) rinse, native oxide thickness <= 0.6 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized passive native oxide surface with validated 49-point thickness <= 1.2 nm, ready for high-temperature gate oxidation or SACVD pre-clean without organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (>1.5 nm) and ambient airborne hydrocarbon adsorption in cleanroom air altering surface chemical termination, resulting in gate oxide breakdown voltage degradation, threshold voltage shift, and loss of DRAM transfer transistor subthreshold slope.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full non-destructive qualification and spatial contour mapping of native silicon oxide thickness and refractive index across 49 polar coordinate sites on RCA-cleaned wafers, establishing baseline interfacial oxide control for the 180nm DRAM gate stack module.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RCA2_MET_NATIVE_OXIDE_49PT_MAP_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `SPECTROSCOPIC_ELLIPSOMETRY_CONTOUR_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `RAW_PSI_DELTA_POLAR_DISPERSION_SCAN.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean native oxide thickness across all 49 polar wafer measurement points must conform to post-clean native baseline.** | `0.85 nm` | +/- 0.35 nm | Multi-site Cauchy-model regression fit from automated spectroscopic ellipsometry scan (245-1000 nm). |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Wafer-level radial thickness non-uniformity across 49 points with 3 mm edge exclusion.** | `2.8%` | <= 4.0% (1-sigma / mean) | Statistical process calculation of 49-point spatial thickness distribution. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Refractive index evaluated at 632.8 nm extracted from cardinal multi-angle points.** | `1.462` | +/- 0.015 | Coupled multi-angle goniometer VASE regression at 65 deg, 70 deg, and 75 deg incidence. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 49 wafer sites successfully fitted with Mean Squared Error (MSE) <= 2.5, mean native oxide thickness within 0.50 nm - 1.20 nm, 1-sigma non-uniformity <= 4.0%, zero points exceeding 1.50 nm, and CSV data artifact signed off and bound to the MES lot tracking sequence within the 30-minute queue-time window.
