critics.laya_pm: Metrology overhead must not bottleneck the wet bench throughput: 49-point wafer mapping must maintain a cycle time of <=120 seconds per wafer including robotic load/unload. If the metrology queue exceeds 30 minutes in cleanroom ambient air following DHF/RCA-2 clean, native oxide exceeds the 0.8 nm gate threshold and forces a non-conformance wafer scrap/re-clean cycle, severely degrading line yield.
critical_failure_modes: Thickness-refractive index parameter cross-correlation artifact leading to unphysical n values (e.g., n > 1.65 or n < 1.35) while masking true interfacial chemical oxide thickness.
Ambient oxidation gradient induced during lengthy stage mapping, corrupting the radial uniformity (1-sigma > 5%) metric.
Misalignment of optical beam focal plane due to wafer bow/warp (>30 um) causing signal depolarization and fit goodness (MSE) exceeding threshold.

testcases.title: 49-Point Polar Polarimetric Native Oxide Thickness and Uniformity Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Multi-Wavelength Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (245-1000 nm, 70 deg incident angle, automated motorized r-theta stage, beam spot diameter <= 100 um)
testcases.pre_conditions: Ellipsometer calibrated against NIST-traceable 2.0 nm SiO2/Si standard with baseline Mean Squared Error (MSE) < 1.5; 150mm/200mm p-type Si(100) test wafer processed through RCA-1, DHF strip, and RCA-2 with final spin-rinse-dry completed <=15 minutes prior; wafer staged inside clean mini-environment (Class 1 FOUP or SMIF pod with continuous N2 purge).
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer onto vacuum chuck with flat/notch alignment at 0 degrees.
2. Execute automated 49-point concentric ring polar map recipe with 3 mm edge exclusion (Center: 1 pt; Ring 1 (r=0.25R): 8 pts; Ring 2 (r=0.50R): 12 pts; Ring 3 (r=0.75R): 16 pts; Ring 4 (r=0.95R): 12 pts).
3. Collect polarization ratio rho = tan(Psi) * exp(i * Delta) across 245-1000 nm spectrum at each site.
4. Fit measured spectra to a two-layer model (Si Substrate / Native SiO2 with Cauchy dispersion n(lambda)=A + B/lambda^2, A=1.465, B=0.004 um^2, k=0).
5. Extract thickness (t_ox) and Mean Squared Error (MSE) per point; compute wafer mean thickness and 1-sigma percent standard deviation.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Wafer Mean Thickness: 0.5 nm <= t_ox <= 1.2 nm; Radial Uniformity: 1-sigma <= 4.0%; Optical Fit Goodness: MSE <= 2.5 across all 49 measurement sites.

testcases.title: Refractive Index Stability and Multi-Angle Dispersion Validation
testcases.instrumentation: Variable Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE) equipped with multi-angle goniometer (65 deg, 70 deg, 75 deg) and micro-spot optics
testcases.pre_conditions: Spectroscopic light source warmed up for >=45 minutes; dark current baseline calibrated; wafer positioned on temperature-stabilized vacuum chuck at 22.0 +/- 0.5 deg C.
testcases.procedure:
1. Position measurement beam at center site (Point 1) and 4 cardinal peripheral sites (Points 13, 25, 37, 49).
2. Acquire spectroscopic Psi and Delta profiles at three distinct angles of incidence: 65.0 deg, 70.0 deg, and 75.0 deg.
3. Perform coupled optical regression letting thickness and refractive index parameter A_n float simultaneously.
4. Verify that residual correlation coefficient between thickness and refractive index does not exceed |0.90|.
5. Extract refractive index value evaluated at standard HeNe laser wavelength (lambda = 632.8 nm).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Refractive Index at 632.8 nm: 1.450 <= n <= 1.470; Correlation Coefficient: |Corr(t, n)| < 0.90; Residual Fit Goodness: MSE <= 2.0.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom clean vinyl/nitrile gloves with double-gloving protocol
UV-filtering laser safety glasses rated for Class 1/Class 2 laser positioning diodes (ANSI Z136.1 compliant)
Static-dissipative cleanroom gown, hood, ESD footwear, and face mask

cas_chemicals.name: Compressed Nitrogen Gas (Purge and Chuck Float)
Silicon Dioxide (Native Surface Oxide Matrix on Silicon)

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For nitrogen asphyxiation hazard from line rupture: Immediately evacuate personnel to fresh air, activate emergency oxygen supply, and perform CPR if breathing has ceased. For IPA eye/skin contact: Irrigate exposed eyes with copious clean water for >=15 minutes at cleanroom emergency eye-wash station; remove contaminated clothing and wash skin thoroughly with soap and water.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Tool ambient enclosure maintained under ISO Class 4 laminar HEPA/ULPA downflow (0.45 m/s +/- 20%); internal stage mini-environment vented via dedicated general cleanroom exhaust (min 50 CFM) to prevent nitrogen build-up or ozone accumulation generated by short-wavelength D2 UV lamps.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: No hazardous liquid effluent generated during optical metrology. IPA cleaning wipes must be disposed of in dedicated airtight hazardous flammables disposal bins lined with anti-static bags and processed according to SEMI S2 cleanroom waste guidelines.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophobic to weakly hydrophilic hydrogen/fluorine-terminated silicon surface immediately following dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF 1:50) strip and ultra-pure water (UPW) rinse, native oxide thickness <= 0.6 nm.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Characterized passive native oxide surface with validated 49-point thickness <= 1.2 nm, ready for high-temperature gate oxidation or SACVD pre-clean without organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (>1.5 nm) and ambient airborne hydrocarbon adsorption in cleanroom air altering surface chemical termination, resulting in gate oxide breakdown voltage degradation, threshold voltage shift, and loss of DRAM transfer transistor subthreshold slope.

expected_result.summary: Full non-destructive qualification and spatial contour mapping of native silicon oxide thickness and refractive index across 49 polar coordinate sites on RCA-cleaned wafers, establishing baseline interfacial oxide control for the 180nm DRAM gate stack module.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Mean native oxide thickness across all 49 polar wafer measurement points must conform to post-clean native baseline.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Multi-site Cauchy-model regression fit from automated spectroscopic ellipsometry scan (245-1000 nm).

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Wafer-level radial thickness non-uniformity across 49 points with 3 mm edge exclusion.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Statistical process calculation of 49-point spatial thickness distribution.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Refractive index evaluated at 632.8 nm extracted from cardinal multi-angle points.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Coupled multi-angle goniometer VASE regression at 65 deg, 70 deg, and 75 deg incidence.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All 49 wafer sites successfully fitted with Mean Squared Error (MSE) <= 2.5, mean native oxide thickness within 0.50 nm - 1.20 nm, 1-sigma non-uniformity <= 4.0%, zero points exceeding 1.50 nm, and CSV data artifact signed off and bound to the MES lot tracking sequence within the 30-minute queue-time window.

nodes.label: Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Trace Metal & Surface Particle Qualification
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Trace Metal & Surface Particle Qualification

**Module:** Metrology / Wet Chemistry Clean Qualification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Node)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Benchtop / Automated TXRF Metrology Tool)  
**Parent Process:** Surface Particle & Native Oxide Ellipsometric/TXRF Metrology Inspection after RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Sequence  

---

### 1. Principle & Operational Workflow

Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) inspects silicon wafer surfaces for critical transition metal contamination (such as Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn) down to trace levels ($< 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$) along with complementary optical/ellipsometric thickness checks. Incident X-rays strike the surface below the critical angle of total external reflection ($\Phi_c \approx 0.1^\circ$), preventing penetration into the silicon bulk and exciting only surface-layer impurities to safeguard DRAM capacitor junctions and gate oxide integrity against leakage.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Step 1: Automated Load & Pre-Alignment"] --> B["Step 2: Total Reflection Angle Calibration (Φ < Φc)"]
    B --> C["Step 3: Multi-Point TXRF Spectrum Acquisition"]
    C --> D["Step 4: Complementary Ellipsometric Confirmation"]
    D --> E["Step 5: Wafer Pass/Fail Dispo & Recipe Handshake"]
```

#### Step-by-Step Procedure:
1. **Wafer Transfer & Pre-Alignment:**
   - Transfer the cleaned test wafer from the RCA-1/DHF/RCA-2 wet bench output cassette to the TXRF tool loadlock using automated edge-handling end-effectors under cleanroom ISO Class 1 conditions.
   - Run notch/flat pre-alignment to lock wafer orientation (0° reference).

2. **Angle Calibration & Critical Angle Tuning:**
   - Adjust the incident X-ray beam angle ($\Phi$) below the total reflection critical threshold ($\Phi \approx 0.05^\circ - 0.10^\circ$) via automated goniometer fine-pitch rocking curve alignment.
   - Verify minimal silicon substrate background scatter ($I_{\text{Si-K}\alpha}$) to ensure true surface sensitivity.

3. **Multi-Point TXRF Trace Metal Acquisition:**
   - Execute an automated radial scan (e.g., center, half-radius, and edge-exclusion boundary at 3 mm) using Mo-$K\alpha$ or W-target excitation.
   - Collect fluorescent X-ray photons via Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) for a calibrated live time (typically 300–600 s/point).
   - Integrate peak areas for transition metals (Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn) that act as deep-level recombination-generation traps detrimental to retention time.

4. **Correlated Native Oxide/Dielectric Ellipsometric Check:**
   - For wafers processed through DHF oxide strip prior to clean finish, measure residual chemical or native oxide via Spectroscopic Ellipsometry on an automated 9-point or 49-point wafer map tracking parameter angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$.

5. **Data Logging & Clean Bench Feedback:**
   - Extract areal elemental density ($\text{atoms/cm}^2$) per point against verified reference calibration standards.
   - Log data to the fab metrology database and release the lot for gate oxide growth or stacked capacitor processing.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Leakage Current Budget Baseline** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell (at } 85^\circ\text{C)}$ | Parametric electrical test / junction leakage qualification |
| **Cell Capacitance Target** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Metrology C-V qualification on stacked capacitor monitor |
| **Gate / Native Dielectric Thickness Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ (sub-Ångstrom precision on thin oxide target of $3.5\text{ nm}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi$, $\Delta$ dispersion mapping) |
| **Radial Wafer Mapping Density** | $9\text{-point or } 49\text{-point}$ | Points / Wafer | Automated wafer map tracking radial non-uniformity |

---

### 3. Citations & Literature Context

- **Capacitance & Leakage Limits:**
  - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
    *"Capacitance Budget: Minimum 28 fF per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance. Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval..."* (Trace metal qualification directly safeguards this junction leakage budget).
- **Ellipsometric Precision & Wafer Map Tracking:**
  - *Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*  
    *"Measurement Precision: Dry gate oxide (3.5 nm) measured with sub-Angstrom precision (±0.05 nm)... Wafer Mapping: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs."*
- **Interconnect Baseline Context:**
  - *Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*  
    *(Referenced for cleanroom baseline compatibility and post-clean metallization constraints).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Purchasing dedicated in-house TXRF instrumentation for Gen 1 (mm-scale discrete 180nm DRAM test vehicles) is economically unviable and technically disproportionate compared to commercial foundry beamline/analytical lab service contracts. Total reflection conditions (critical angle ~0.1° to 0.18° for Mo-Kalpha on silicon) are highly sensitive to surface roughness (RMS must be <0.5 nm) and edge bevel scattering; if wafer warpage or bow exceeds 25 µm, grazing incidence fails, leading to bulk excitation and catastrophic background noise floor inflation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM gate oxide and retention integrity, trace transition metals (Fe, Ni, Cu) must remain strictly below 1e10 atoms/cm^2, as Fe interstitial deep-level traps and Cu precipitates at the LOCOS/STI trench isolation edges drastically elevate junction leakage. While TXRF provides direct, non-destructive surface quantification down to ~1e9 to 1e10 atoms/cm^2 without wet matrix digestion, it is insensitive to light mobile ionic contaminants like Na+ and K+, which directly cause DRAM access transistor Vth drift and require complementary SIMS or VPD-ICP-MS monitoring.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring cleanroom-certified TXRF metrology tools (such as Rigaku TXRF-3760 or Bruker S2 PICOFOX) incurs severe lead times exceeding 9 to 14 months and high capital expenditure ($400k-$1.2M), alongside specialized vacuum pump and high-power X-ray tube (Mo/W anode) consumables. A third-party testing partnership (analytical service bureau) must be established as the primary baseline for pilot wafer lots, with certified clean transport pods (polycarbonate FOUP/cassette purged with 99.9999% N2) to prevent shipping-induced airborne molecular contamination.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput for comprehensive wafer mapping (e.g., 9-point or 49-point TXRF with 500-1000s integration per point) introduces a severe 12-to-24 hour bottleneck per qualification lot, colliding directly with tight post-cleaning Q-time constraints prior to thermal gate oxidation. Clear lot-sampling protocols (1 monitor wafer per 25-wafer RCA lot) must be locked in the routing schedule to prevent queuing delays from causing native oxide regrowths or uncontrolled organic vapor adsorption.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Grazing-angle misalignment (>0.02° deviation from critical angle theta_c = 0.158° for Si at Mo-Kalpha 17.44 keV) inducing bulk penetration, causing Si substrate fluorescence saturation and total suppression of trace metal peak detection (Fe-Kalpha at 6.40 keV, Ni-Kalpha at 7.47 keV, Cu-Kalpha at 8.04 keV).
1. Airborne Molecular Contamination (AMC) and volatile sulfur/siloxane/amine adsorption inside the TXRF loadlock or during inter-bay transit exceeding 30 minutes, artificially distorting surface carbon/trace chemical baselines and causing false RCA clean rejection.
1. Surface microroughness degradation (RMS > 0.8 nm) caused by etching/bath non-uniformity during HF/RCA-1 cleaning, which scatters the incident X-ray beam, destroying the standing wave field and invalidating standard relative sensitivity factors (RSF).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-3-3-01` | **TXRF Trace Transition Metal Surface Contamination Quantification (Fe, Ni, Cu)** | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence Spectrometer (Rigaku TXRF-3760 or equivalent with Mo-Kalpha X-ray tube operated at 40 kV / 40 mA, W/C monochromator, Si(Li) or Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) with <140 eV FWHM resolution at Mn-Kalpha). | 1. Load wafer into TXRF auto-loader and initiate chamber pump-down to high vacuum (<5e-4 Pa). 2. Perform automated optical and X-ray reflectivity alignment to determine critical angle theta_c on the silicon surface (nominal 0.158°). 3. Set grazing incidence angle to 0.100° (below theta_c) to ensure total external reflection mode. 4. Execute 9-point automated surface map (center, 4 points at r=35mm, 4 points at r=65mm with 5mm edge exclusion). 5. Collect X-ray fluorescence energy spectrum at each site for 1000 seconds live-time over 0 to 20 keV. 6. Deconvolute spectrum using fundamental parameter matrix and quantify peak areas for Fe-Kalpha (6.40 keV), Ni-Kalpha (7.47 keV), and Cu-Kalpha (8.04 keV). | `PASS if for all 9 measurement points: Surface concentration of Fe <= 1.0e10 atoms/cm^2, Ni <= 5.0e9 atoms/cm^2, and Cu <= 5.0e9 atoms/cm^2. FAIL if any single point exceeds 1.0e10 atoms/cm^2 for Fe, or 5.0e9 atoms/cm^2 for Ni or Cu.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-2-3-3-02` | **Post-Clean Surface Particle Defect Density & High-Angle Scatter Qualification** | Automated Laser Surface Particle Scanner / Defect Inspection System (KLA-Tencor Surfscan 6220 or equivalent 488nm solid-state laser scanning system) coupled with TXRF alignment verification. | 1. Load processed wafer onto vacuum chuck of surface particle scanner. 2. Scan entire 150mm wafer surface using dark-field scatterometry with a 5mm edge exclusion zone. 3. Bin detected light point defects (LPD) into size categories: 0.18 µm - 0.3 µm, 0.3 µm - 0.5 µm, and >0.5 µm. 4. Correlate coordinate map with TXRF test locations to verify no macro-particle (>1.0 µm) sits within the 8mm diameter TXRF X-ray interrogation spot. | `PASS if total particle density for defects >= 0.2 µm is <= 0.05 particles/cm^2 across the active wafer area (equivalent to <= 8 total particles on a 150mm wafer with 5mm edge exclusion) and 0 particles > 1.0 µm within any planned TXRF measurement zone. FAIL otherwise.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom full-body Tyvek coverall with integrated hood and boot covers, Triple-layer cleanroom gloves (Class 100 clean nitrile outer layer over chemical-resistant polychloroprene inner), High-impact polycarbonate safety glasses with side shields meeting ANSI Z87.1, Personal thermoluminescent dosimeter (TLD) / electronic radiation dosimeter badge worn on torso
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For ionizing radiation: Immediately engage emergency X-ray interlock/shutter kill switch; isolate unit; log badge dosimeter reading and seek medical dosimetry evaluation. For trace HF exposure during wet prep: Flush affected area with cold running water for 5 minutes, immediately apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel massage continuously into skin until pain subsides; seek emergency hospital care. Eye splash: Irrigate with sterile isotonic saline or 1% calcium gluconate ophthalmic solution for at least 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: TXRF vacuum turbomolecular pump backing exhaust must be hard-piped directly to the dedicated cleanroom hazardous solvent/acid exhaust duct (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s, negative static pressure >= 250 Pa). Lead-lined radiation enclosure shielding must comply with 21 CFR 1020.40 (<0.5 mR/hr / <5 µSv/hr at 5 cm from outer chassis with interlocks active).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous chemical prep rinse waste routed to dedicated automated acid-waste neutralization (AWN) system utilizing 20% NaOH dosing to neutralize to pH 6.5-8.5 with precipitation of fluoride salts via calcium chloride (CaCl2) additions. Solid-state consumables (wipes, contaminated wafers) classified as heavy-metal/fluoride hazardous solid waste and sealed in double-bagged poly drums.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (pre-metrology surface clean / calibration)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI/ULSI) | `0.5% - 49% aqueous` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (RCA-1/RCA-2 bath component)** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI) | `30% aqueous` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (RCA-1 bath component)** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI) | `29% aqueous` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (RCA-2 bath component)** | `7647-01-0` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI) | `37% aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic clean native chemical oxide (~0.8 nm to 1.2 nm SiO2) terminated with Si-OH groups following RCA-2 (HCl/H2O2/H2O) clean and megasonic spin-rinse-dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Non-destructively inspected, particle-qualified wafer maintaining undamaged ultra-thin oxide passivation layer, zero radiation damage to substrate, free of organic AMC residue.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces spontaneous adsorption of airborne molecular organics (plasticizers, siloxanes, isopropyl alcohol vapors) and uncontrolled atmospheric boron/sulfur deposition, resulting in localized dielectric breakdown and threshold voltage (Vth) instability in subsequent 180nm gate dielectric growth.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full quantitative qualification report verifying that the RCA wet cleaning sequence meets the strict 180nm DRAM metal contamination limits (<1.0e10 atoms/cm^2 Fe, <5.0e9 atoms/cm^2 Ni and Cu) and particle cleanliness (<0.05 particles/cm^2 >=0.2 µm) across 150mm prime silicon wafers, enabling release of downstream gate oxidation and capacitor LOCOS/isolation modules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TXRF_9Point_TraceMetal_Quantitative_Map.csv`
- [ ] `Surface_Particle_Scatter_Defect_Map_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Raw_Fluorescence_Energy_Spectra_Deconvolution.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Areal surface density of iron (Fe) measured by TXRF across all mapped points must be below threshold to prevent silicon bandgap recombination centers.** | `7.5e9 atoms/cm^2` | <= 1.0e10 atoms/cm^2 | TXRF spectrometry under grazing incidence (0.100°) using Mo-Kalpha excitation at 1000s dwell time per site. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Areal surface density of copper (Cu) and nickel (Ni) to prevent gate oxide dielectric breakdown and junction leakage.** | `3.0e9 atoms/cm^2` | <= 5.0e9 atoms/cm^2 | TXRF spectral deconvolution of Cu-Kalpha (8.04 keV) and Ni-Kalpha (7.47 keV) peak areas calibrated against certified standard. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-clean total surface particle density for particles >= 0.2 µm on 150mm wafer.** | `0.025 particles/cm^2` | <= 0.05 particles/cm^2 | Laser dark-field light scatter inspection (488nm laser scanner, 5mm edge exclusion). |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher signoff requires 3 consecutive monitor wafer qualification runs demonstrating Fe < 1.0e10 atoms/cm^2, Ni/Cu < 5.0e9 atoms/cm^2, particle density <= 0.05 particles/cm^2 (>=0.2 µm), with formal signoffs from Metrology Lead and DRAM Wet Integration Engineer uploaded to the Foundation quality registry.

Triple-layer cleanroom gloves (Class 100 clean nitrile outer layer over chemical-resistant polychloroprene inner)
High-impact polycarbonate safety glasses with side shields meeting ANSI Z87.1
Personal thermoluminescent dosimeter (TLD) / electronic radiation dosimeter badge worn on torso
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For ionizing radiation: Immediately engage emergency X-ray interlock/shutter kill switch; isolate unit; log badge dosimeter reading and seek medical dosimetry evaluation. For trace HF exposure during wet prep: Flush affected area with cold running water for 5 minutes, immediately apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel massage continuously into skin until pain subsides; seek emergency hospital care. Eye splash: Irrigate with sterile isotonic saline or 1% calcium gluconate ophthalmic solution for at least 15 minutes.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: TXRF vacuum turbomolecular pump backing exhaust must be hard-piped directly to the dedicated cleanroom hazardous solvent/acid exhaust duct (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s, negative static pressure >= 250 Pa). Lead-lined radiation enclosure shielding must comply with 21 CFR 1020.40 (<0.5 mR/hr / <5 µSv/hr at 5 cm from outer chassis with interlocks active).
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Aqueous chemical prep rinse waste routed to dedicated automated acid-waste neutralization (AWN) system utilizing 20% NaOH dosing to neutralize to pH 6.5-8.5 with precipitation of fluoride salts via calcium chloride (CaCl2) additions. Solid-state consumables (wipes, contaminated wafers) classified as heavy-metal/fluoride hazardous solid waste and sealed in double-bagged poly drums.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophilic clean native chemical oxide (~0.8 nm to 1.2 nm SiO2) terminated with Si-OH groups following RCA-2 (HCl/H2O2/H2O) clean and megasonic spin-rinse-dry.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Non-destructively inspected, particle-qualified wafer maintaining undamaged ultra-thin oxide passivation layer, zero radiation damage to substrate, free of organic AMC residue.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding Q-time induces spontaneous adsorption of airborne molecular organics (plasticizers, siloxanes, isopropyl alcohol vapors) and uncontrolled atmospheric boron/sulfur deposition, resulting in localized dielectric breakdown and threshold voltage (Vth) instability in subsequent 180nm gate dielectric growth.

expected_result.summary: Full quantitative qualification report verifying that the RCA wet cleaning sequence meets the strict 180nm DRAM metal contamination limits (<1.0e10 atoms/cm^2 Fe, <5.0e9 atoms/cm^2 Ni and Cu) and particle cleanliness (<0.05 particles/cm^2 >=0.2 µm) across 150mm prime silicon wafers, enabling release of downstream gate oxidation and capacitor LOCOS/isolation modules.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Areal surface density of iron (Fe) measured by TXRF across all mapped points must be below threshold to prevent silicon bandgap recombination centers.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: TXRF spectrometry under grazing incidence (0.100°) using Mo-Kalpha excitation at 1000s dwell time per site.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Areal surface density of copper (Cu) and nickel (Ni) to prevent gate oxide dielectric breakdown and junction leakage.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: TXRF spectral deconvolution of Cu-Kalpha (8.04 keV) and Ni-Kalpha (7.47 keV) peak areas calibrated against certified standard.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Post-clean total surface particle density for particles >= 0.2 µm on 150mm wafer.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Laser dark-field light scatter inspection (488nm laser scanner, 5mm edge exclusion).

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Researcher signoff requires 3 consecutive monitor wafer qualification runs demonstrating Fe < 1.0e10 atoms/cm^2, Ni/Cu < 5.0e9 atoms/cm^2, particle density <= 0.05 particles/cm^2 (>=0.2 µm), with formal signoffs from Metrology Lead and DRAM Wet Integration Engineer uploaded to the Foundation quality registry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology
**Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line [Chemical Processing] > Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology [Metrology]  
**Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage Post-Clean Wafer (Post-RCA1 / RCA2)  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Laser Surface Scanner / Dark-Field Metrology │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   DI Water Micro-Droplet Sessile Dispense   │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Optical Goniometric Contact Angle Inspection │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   Quality Acceptance & Disposition to Dry    │
│      Oxidation (850°C-900°C SiO2 Growth)     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Loading**:
   - Following standard RCA-1/RCA-2 cleans and rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse, transfer wafer under laminar flow using vacuum tweezers or edge-grip handling.
   - Stage wafer onto the macroscopic optical/laser metrology stage with positional alignment fixture calibrated to Gen 1 macro-placement tolerance ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ / $0.1\ \text{mm}$).

2. **Optical Dark-Field Defect & Particle Metrology**:
   - Align the inspection optical head equipped with a $10\times$ Plan Achromat microscope objective ($\text{NA} = 0.25$).
   - Scan the active wafer field to detect light scattering from residual particulate contamination.
   - Flag any particulate defect exceeding the macro lithography defect ceiling ($\ge 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$, scaled against photoresist thickness).

3. **Sessile Drop DI Water Dispense (Contact Angle)**:
   - Position a calibrated micro-syringe with high-purity DI water normal to the silicon surface.
   - Dispense a sessile micro-droplet ($2.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.5\ \mu\text{L}$) at 5 representative wafer points (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right).
   - Ensure dispense velocity does not induce mechanical droplet bouncing or spreading momentum.

4. **Goniometric Contact Angle Metrology**:
   - Acquire droplet tangent profiles via side-view optical camera and baseline fitting.
   - For post-HF/RCA native oxide-stripped Si surfaces, measure water contact angle $\theta_c$ to verify hydrophobic hydrogen termination.
   - For post-RCA-2 chemical oxide / hydrophilic rinse surfaces prior to thermal gate oxide growth ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$ target thickness $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$), confirm complete surface wetting ($\theta_c < 10^\circ$).

5. **Dry & Cleared Disposition**:
   - Dry inspection drop residues with ultra-pure filtered $\text{N}_2$ gun.
   - Transfer cleared wafers immediately to the furnace staging rack to prevent uncontrolled ambient re-oxidation and airborne particle deposition.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Stage Alignment Margin** | $0.0$ | $\le \pm 100$ ($\pm 0.1$) | $\mu\text{m}$ ($\text{mm}$) | Optical projection stage micrometers |
| **Critical Defect Particle Size Threshold** | $< 1.3$ | Max $< 1.3$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | $10\times$ Plan Achromat ($\text{NA}=0.25$) dark-field scatter |
| **Hydrophilic Passivation Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** *(Pre-Gate Ox)* | $< 10$ | $[0, 10]$ | $\text{deg}\ (^\circ)$ | Automated optical goniometer |
| **Hydrophobic H-Terminated Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** *(Post-dHF)* | $> 70$ | $[70, 85]$ | $\text{deg}\ (^\circ)$ | Automated optical goniometer |

---

### 3. Citations & Context Alignment

- **Alignment & Inspection Optics**:
  - *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: Stable macroscopic stage, $10\times$ Plan Achromat ($\text{NA}=0.25$) objective for optical inspection, DI water rinse standard, and Gen 1 alignment tolerance of $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ ($0.1\ \text{mm}$).
  - *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: Photoresist layer reference thickness $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ utilized as defect filtration baseline.
- **Surface Clean & Subsequent Growth Integration**:
  - *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*: Pre-clean state required directly upstream of thermally grown gate $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ physical thickness.
  - *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*: Substrate interface control targeting minimum channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ and width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$ transistor gates to prevent leakage exceeding $1\ \text{fA/cell}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-clean metrology must act as an inline gatekeeper without causing secondary cross-contamination. Placing contact angle goniometry in open air risks airborne organic contaminant redeposition onto freshly stripped HF-last or RCA-cleaned surfaces. A dedicated mini-environment or localized high-purity N2 purge enclosure around the stage is required to prevent rapid hydrophobic decay during 5-point wafer mapping.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Surface termination following standard RCA cleaning dictates distinct wettability regimes: RCA-1/RCA-2 finishes with a hydrophilic chemical oxide yielding water contact angles below 5 degrees, whereas an HF-dip finish leaves a hydrogen-terminated silicon surface (Si-H) exhibiting strong hydrophobicity with contact angles between 75 and 85 degrees. Goniometry droplet volume must be restricted to 1-2 microliters of 18.2 MOhm-cm ultra-pure water (UPW) using sessile drop fitting (Young-Laplace) to avoid droplet collapse, gravity distortion, or pinhole-induced localized dissolution.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated industrial particle scanners (KLA/Tencor Surfscan) are inaccessible for Gen 1 open-source fabs due to capital expenditure constraints. Sourcing benchtop darkfield optical microscopy with high-intensity grazing-angle 405nm LED illumination and a calibrated sessile-drop goniometer using open-source image analysis (ImageJ/DropAnalysis) provides an economically viable alternative with readily available replacement optics and quartz micro-syringes.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput must not bottleneck the fab line. The post-clean queue time (Q-time) window to subsequent dry oxidation or thin-film deposition is strictly limited to 30 minutes in cleanroom air. Manual contact angle verification and 5-point darkfield particle counting must execute within 8 minutes per 100mm wafer to preserve downstream furnace loading windows.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Secondary airborne hydrocarbon adsorption during droplet dispensing causing false hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic angle drift (>15 deg error).
1. Evaporative residue and trace organic/metallic precipitation from contaminated dispenser syringe tips creating artificial particle defect clusters.
1. Capillary condensation and local native oxide regrwoth on hydrogen-terminated silicon due to excessive ambient relative humidity (>45% RH) during measurement.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-01` | **Post-HF Hydrogen-Termination Hydrophobic Contact Angle Verification** | Optical Goniometer with CMOS camera, 1-5 uL precision micro-dispenser with fluoropolymer-coated needle, 18.2 MOhm-cm Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) | 1. Mount wafer onto vibration-isolated vacuum chuck under localized laminar N2 purge. 2. Dispense a 2.0 uL sessile droplet of 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW at center, 0.5R (North, South, East, West) totaling 5 points. 3. Capture droplet profile images at 30 fps within 3 seconds of droplet detachment. 4. Calculate static contact angle via Young-Laplace contour fitting algorithm across all 5 points. | `Pass if mean static contact angle across 5 points is >= 75.0 degrees with within-wafer standard deviation <= 3.0 degrees, verifying uniform hydrogen termination without residual chemical oxide.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-02` | **Post-RCA Surface Defect & Particle Darkfield Inspection** | Darkfield Optical Microscope (5x/0.15 NA and 20x/0.40 NA objectives), 405nm grazing incidence LED illuminator, automated X-Y scanning stage, digital particle counter software | 1. Load wafer onto stage and align notch/flat. 2. Perform raster scan over a 50mm x 50mm active area using darkfield scattering mode under 405nm grazing illumination. 3. Threshold scattered light signals corresponding to particle scatterers >= 1.0 um equivalent optical diameter. 4. Tally total particle counts and generate defect coordinate map. | `Pass if total surface particle density is <= 0.5 particles/cm2 for particle sizes >= 1.0 um, with zero detected clusters (>= 3 particles within 500 um radius).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, ESD-safe chemical-resistant cleanroom smock and hood, Shoe covers and particulate facemask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with cleaning solvents (IPA), flush immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes and seek medical evaluation if irritation persists. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move individual to fresh cleanroom make-up air. In case of accidental contact with residual wafer surface acid traces from unrinsed chemistry, treat affected area with copious water rinse followed by calcium gluconate gel application if HF exposure is suspected.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within laminar flow hood providing ISO Class 5 (Class 100) HEPA-filtered downward air flow (face velocity 0.45 m/s ± 0.05 m/s) with localized solvent point-exhaust for IPA stage maintenance wipes.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous droplet discharge and syringe flush waste collected in designated poly-carboy containers for pH verification (neutral 6.5-7.5) before routing to municipal neutralization system. IPA wipe waste disposed of in airtight, fire-rated hazardous solvent waste bins.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (ASTM D5127 Type E-1.2) | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for Stage/Needle Cleaning** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/MOS Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purge/Dry)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra High Purity (UHP) 5.0 Grade | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched and dried hydrogen-terminated Si (post-DHF) or hydrophilic chemical oxide (post-SC-2) free of macro-droplets.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Verified clean, particle-mapped, dried surface with verified surface energy state, ready for gate oxidation or dielectric LPCVD.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes native oxide growth (>0.5 nm uncontrolled SiO2), organic airborne carbon contamination (loss of Si-H passivated sites), and degraded gate dielectric breakdown voltage (Vbd) in the final DRAM cell capacitor/transistor.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Validation of post-clean surface purity and termination uniformity on 100mm wafers via 5-point contact angle goniometry and grazing darkfield particulate defect mapping, ensuring surface cleanliness criteria for 180nm gate and capacitor dielectric growth are met within strict Q-time windows.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RCA_CLEAN_METROLOGY_REPORT_BATCH_01.pdf`
- [ ] `WAFER_PARTICLE_MAP_DARKFIELD_5PT.csv`
- [ ] `CONTACT_ANGLE_DROPLET_PROFILES_RAW.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean static contact angle for HF-last hydrogen-terminated silicon** | `78.0 deg` | ± 3.0 deg | 5-point Young-Laplace sessile drop analysis using optical goniometer |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-clean surface defect and particle density for features >= 1.0 um** | `0.35 particles/cm2` | <= 0.50 particles/cm2 | Automated 405nm grazing darkfield optical raster scanning |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Measurement cycle time per wafer to preserve Q-time** | `360 seconds` | <= 480 seconds | Automated batch run execution timestamp logging |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All tested wafers exhibit mean contact angle >= 75.0 degrees (for HF-last Si-H) or <= 5.0 degrees (for RCA-2 chemical oxide), particle density <= 0.50 particles/cm2 with zero clusters, complete deliverables archived in repository, and transfer to furnace loadlock completed within 30 minutes of clean cycle dry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Calibration of Laser Surface Particle Scanner & Baseline Drift Check

**Module:** Metrology / Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Start Baseline Drift  │
│     & Calibration      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Standard PSL      │
│   Calibration Wafer    │
│          Load          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Radial & XY Scan    │
│       Alignment        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Baseline Background   │
│      Noise Check       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Acceptance       │
│   Verification & Log   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Calibration Setup & Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Power on the laser surface particle scanner optical source and stage controllers.
   - Verify that the optical projection/objective enclosure and scan stage have thermally stabilized to ambient cleanroom/operating conditions.

2. **Calibration Standard Loading**:
   - Load a clean reference calibration standard wafer (silicon wafer deposited with NIST-traceable Polystyrene Latex [PSL] calibration spheres) onto the vacuum chuck.
   - Align the wafer notch/flat using the Gen 2 precision mechanical and optical aligner system.

3. **Stage Alignment & Baseline Drift Verification**:
   - Engage automated XY scanning across the wafer plane.
   - Calibrate stage position repeatability to maintain coordinate fidelity across successive sweeps within Gen 2 tolerances (maximum allowable offset $\le \pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$).

4. **Background Noise & Dark Signal Drift Scan**:
   - Execute a blank dark sweep (laser shuttered/idle detector run) across a standard automated multi-point coordinate pattern (e.g., 9-point or 49-point grid) to determine detector electronic noise and background drift.
   - Confirm baseline dark count drift remains stable across the scanning field.

5. **Surface Particle Measurement & Calibration Fit**:
   - Unshutter the laser source and conduct the automated particle sizing scan over the 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping grid.
   - Map scattered intensity peaks to the known reference particle size, verifying calibration curve linearity and sensitivity before clearing the scanner for post-RCA wafer lots.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gen 2 Stage Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical stage encoder calibration check |
| **Scan Grid Configuration** | $9\text{-point or } 49\text{-point}$ | points / wafer | Automated wafer mapping trajectory log |
| **Stage Baseline Repeatability (Gen 1 baseline reference)** | $\le \pm 100$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Maximum drift envelope before fine Gen 2 lock-in |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - *Context applied*: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping protocol for radial scan tracking and uniform surface coordinate monitoring.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - *Context applied*: Microscopic optical stage alignment tolerances: Gen 1 baseline tolerance ($\pm 100\,\mu\text{m}$ / $0.1\,\text{mm}$) improving to Gen 2 precision ($\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$) for macroscopic motion control and scanner positioning.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Laser surface particle scanning (LSPS / Surfscan equivalent) requires stringent synchronization between the rotating chuck (r-theta stage) and the photomultiplier tube (PMT) collector optics. For our 180nm DRAM node, baseline drift checks must decouple optomechanical vibration, PMT thermal gain drift, and laser diode power degradation from true surface particle anomalies. Without a calibrated dark-field baseline reference and optical noise subtraction, false-positive LPD (Light Point Defect) counts will corrupt post-RCA clean verification loops.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrating scattering cross-sections using PSL (Polystyrene Latex) sphere deposition standards at 180nm, 200nm, and 500nm bins is essential. For bare silicon post-RCA-1/RCA-2, surface microroughness contributes Rayleigh haze scattering; if the PMT voltage or collection solid angle threshold is miscalibrated, background haze will be misclassified as sub-micron particles, masking critical gate oxide pinhole-forming particulate contaminants.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring traceable NIST-certified PSL calibration wafers (100mm/150mm prime Si substrates with uniform monosize sphere deposition) entails long lead times and high recurring costs. A procurement strategy must secure secondary reusable reference mirror wafers and establish cleanroom storage protocols in dry nitrogen dryboxes to prevent organic contamination and preserve PSL sphere sizing integrity over extended audit cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Routine baseline drift checks and monthly multi-point sensitivity calibrations must be scheduled outside critical furnace and photolithography pre-clean shifts. Down-time must be limited to <= 45 minutes per weekly drift verification; failure to establish a rapid go/no-go qualification protocol will throttle lot transit between chemical processing and gate oxide growth.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. PMT optical gain drift or laser diode output degradation resulting in false low particle counts and undetected micro-masking defects prior to gate oxidation.
1. Organic haze build-up on optical collection mirrors or illumination lenses causing elevated background noise and threshold clipping for <= 180nm PSL equivalents.
1. Chuck runout or vacuum wobble inducing focal plane shifts during r-theta scanning, producing artificial radial banding defect patterns.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-1-01` | **NIST-Traceable PSL Calibration Sphere Sizing & Detection Efficiency Verification** | Laser Surface Particle Scanner (488nm or 405nm solid-state laser, dark-field PMT detector) with NIST-traceable PSL standard wafer (180nm ± 5nm peak deposition) | 1. Load the 180nm PSL calibration standard wafer onto the vacuum chuck. 2. Execute a full-surface r-theta dark-field scan with 3mm edge exclusion. 3. Extract the histogram of detected scattering cross-sections / equivalent optical diameters. 4. Verify peak distribution mean sizing, full-width at half-maximum (FWHM), and total integrated sphere recovery count against the wafer certification sheet. 5. Repeat scan 3 consecutive times to assess repeatability. | `PSL peak sizing mean must be 180nm ± 4nm; FWHM <= 15nm; total defect count recovery within ±5% of certified count; run-to-run repeatability CV (coefficient of variation) < 2.0%.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-1-02` | **Baseline Background Optical Noise & Dark-Field Drift Check** | Super-polished silicon reference mirror wafer (bare Si, surface microroughness Ra < 0.08 nm, verified zero particle count > 150nm) | 1. Load super-polished reference mirror wafer onto the scanner chuck. 2. Perform 5 consecutive full-surface dark-field scans over a 60-minute duration without unloading. 3. Monitor background optical haze (ppm) and spurious false-count LPDs in the 180nm-1000nm bin. 4. Calculate drift slope across the 5 scan runs. | `Total false LPD count <= 3 defects per 150mm wafer across all bins (>= 180nm); mean surface background haze <= 0.12 ppm; drift slope across 1 hour <= 0.01 ppm/hr.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified laser safety glasses tuned to 405nm/488nm wavelength (OD 5+), Full cleanroom bunny suit with face mask and hood, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with IPA: Flush immediately with clean eyewash or DI water for at least 15 minutes. In case of accidental laser eye exposure: Seek immediate medical evaluation by an ophthalmologist. For inhalation of solvent vapors: Move individual to fresh cleanroom air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool exhaust connected to cleanroom dedicated solvent exhaust line (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s); HEPA-filtered laminar airflow hood maintained over chuck loading station.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes and lint-free swabs collected in dedicated grounded solvent waste containers; rinse DI water containing trace PSL residues collected in organic/solvent drain line.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Polystyrene Latex (PSL) Spheres in Aqueous Suspension** | `9003-53-6` | NIST Traceable Analytical Standard | `< 0.1% wt` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-RCA-1/RCA-2 chemically cleaned bare silicon wafer, chemically passivated with thin native/chemical oxide (< 1.5nm) or hydrogen-terminated bare Si.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-qualified clean surface with verified particle density < 0.05 defects/cm2 (size >= 180nm), immediately prepped for gate oxidation or dielectric deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excess ambient exposure leads to airborne molecular contamination (AMC), airborne organic condensation, and native oxide thickening, degrading subsequent gate oxide dielectric breakdown voltage (BVox).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed laser surface particle scanner multi-point optical calibration and baseline stability qualification, demonstrating precise detection efficiency at the 180nm PSL bin with verified zero-drift background haze for DRAM production gate pre-clean monitoring.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `LSPS_180nm_PSL_Calibration_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Baseline_Haze_and_Drift_Log.csv`
- [ ] `Wafer_Particle_Map_Scan_Results.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **PSL peak detection accuracy for 180nm standard spheres** | `180.0 nm` | ± 4.0 nm | Histogram peak Gaussian fit on calibrated dark-field channel |
| `ASSERT-02` | **False defect count on super-polished reference mirror wafer** | `0` | <= 3 defects/wafer (150mm) | Full-surface scanning across 5 consecutive runs with 3mm edge exclusion |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Optical background haze baseline stability** | `0.10 ppm` | ± 0.02 ppm | Continuous 60-minute background scatter integration |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions satisfied across 3 consecutive qualification cycles; certified calibration curve updated in tool software; formal approval by Metrology Lead and DRAM Process Integration Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Recipe Qualification

- **Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-WCA-001`
- **Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Post-Clean Metrology
- **Action Type:** Make / Recipe Qualification
- **Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)
- **Target Substrate:** 180nm / SKY130-compatible 150mm/200mm p-type/n-type bare and patterned silicon test wafers

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Start: RCA Cleaned   │
│         Wafer          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Goniometer Auto-Load  │
│     & Vacuum Chuck     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Micro-Sessile Drop   │
│  Dispensing: 1.0-2.0   │
│  uL UPW 18.2 MOhm-cm   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    High-Speed Video    │
│    Edge Detection:     │
│     Young-Laplace      │
│        Fitting         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│     WCA Evaluation     │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├───────────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────╮
             │ Hydrophilic Oxide (< 5°)          │ Hydrophobic H-Terminated (> 75°)    │ Out of Spec
             ▼                                   ▼                                     ▼
┌────────────────────────┐          ┌────────────────────────┐            ┌────────────────────────┐
│    SC-1 / SC-2 Pass    │          │      HF Dip Pass       │            │    Trigger Rework /    │
│   (Hydrated Surface)   │          │ (Complete Dewetting)   │            │  Bath Excursion Alarm  │
└────────────────────────┘          └────────────────────────┘            └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the automated execution and recipe qualification for Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) metrology across the wet clean line. It quantifies surface wettability, chemical oxide formation, and hydrogen termination following RCA-1 (SC-1), dilute HF native oxide strip, and RCA-2 (SC-2) cleaning steps prior to high-temperature furnace diffusion/oxidation.

---

### 2. Equipment, Chemistry & Metrology Setup
1. **Automated Contact Angle Goniometer**:
   - Motorized automated $X$-$Y$-$\theta$ stage with sub-micron positioning.
   - Micro-syringe dispenser with PTFE needle tip (gauge 30–32).
   - High-resolution telecentric zoom lens and CMOS camera ($\ge 60\text{ fps}$).
   - Image analysis software supporting Young-Laplace baseline fitting and tangent polynomial algorithms.
2. **Dispense Fluid**: Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) with in-line resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Environmental Enclosure**: Class 1 mini-environment, continuous filtered clean dry air (CDA) or $\text{N}_2$ purge to prevent airborne organic hydrocarbon adsorption.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Operational Checks & UPW Line Verification
1. Verify the goniometer fluid delivery circuit is purged: dispense 10 sacrificial droplets to remove any trapped micro-bubbles.
2. Verify UPW source resistivity displays $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at point-of-use (POU).
3. Execute calibration using a certified optical calibration target (stainless steel sphere or calibration glass slide with known angle certified within $\pm 0.2^\circ$).

#### Step 2: Recipe Parameter Setup & Multi-Site Programming
1. Load recipe `WCA_180NM_RCA_QUAL`:
   - **Droplet Volume:** $1.5\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\ \mu\text{L}$ (ensures gravitational sagging is negligible and Young-Laplace regime holds).
   - **Dosing Rate:** $1.0\ \mu\text{L/s}$ via automated micro-syringe.
   - **Deposition Method:** Bottom-up touch-off (stage approaches droplet to touch substrate, then retracts needle smoothly at $2.0\text{ mm/s}$ without kinetic vibration).
   - **Image Acquisition Window:** $t = 500\text{ ms}$ to $1000\text{ ms}$ post-deposition (records stable equilibrium sessile contact angle prior to evaporation effects).
2. Configure 5-point wafer map (Center, North, South, East, West with $10\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).

#### Step 3: Wafer Loading & Automated Measurement Execution
1. Transfer wafer from the clean line cassette (transferred immediately within $\le 15\text{ minutes}$ post-Marangoni/IPA dry) onto the goniometer vacuum chuck.
2. Engage vacuum chuck ($P \le -70\text{ kPa}$).
3. Initiate auto-measurement:
   - Tool moves stage to coordinate $(X_i, Y_i)$.
   - Needle dispenses $1.5\ \mu\text{L}$ UPW droplet.
   - Camera captures the baseline and droplet profile.
   - Automated edge-detection algorithm fits the droplet contour via the Young-Laplace equation and computes left/right contact angles ($\theta_L$, $\theta_R$).
4. System automatically indexes to the next site, repeating the 5-point measurement.

#### Step 4: Post-Measurement Handling & Pass/Fail Classification
1. Record average contact angle $\overline{\theta} = \frac{1}{2N}\sum_{i=1}^N (\theta_{L,i} + \theta_{R,i})$ and across-wafer standard deviation ($1\sigma$).
2. Evaluate based on process stage:
   - **Post-SC-1 / Post-SC-2:** Confirm complete hydrophilic wetting indicating uniform chemical oxide growth.
   - **Post-Dilute HF Strip:** Confirm hydrophobic dewetting indicating complete removal of native oxide and full H-termination of bare silicon.
3. If measurement falls out of bounds, automatically flag the cleaning batch, quarantine the wafer boat, and trigger bath chemistry replenishment.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Post-Dilute HF Strip Hydrophobic Contact Angle | **$\ge 75.0^\circ$** (Uniform Dewetting across 5 sites) | Degrees ($^\circ$) | Young-Laplace fitted contact angle at 5-point map |
| **AC-02** | Post-RCA-1 / RCA-2 Hydrophilic Contact Angle | **$< 5.0^\circ$** (Complete wetting / spreading) | Degrees ($^\circ$) | Goniometer edge-tangent fit at 5-point map |
| **AC-03** | Dispense Liquid Point-of-Use Resistivity | **$\ge 18.2$** | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductivity/resistivity sensor at $22^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **AC-04** | Sessile Droplet Dosing Volume Precision | **$1.5 \pm 0.2$** | Microliters ($\mu\text{L}$) | Optical telecentric droplet volume integration |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Traceability
- **RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**:
  - *Dilute HF (1:50 to 1:100 HF:UPW, 15–30 s at 22°C)*: Establishes the hydrophobic dewetting transition endpoint where water sheets off bare silicon without wetting (yielding contact angles $\ge 75^\circ$).
  - *RCA-1 (SC-1, 5:1:1 UPW:NH4OH:H2O2 at 70°C–75°C)*: Establishes base-catalyzed micro-etching and re-oxidation yielding a uniform hydrophilic chemical oxide surface ($\theta < 5^\circ$).
  - *RCA-2 (SC-2, 6:1:1 UPW:HCl:H2O2 at 75°C $\pm$ 2°C)*: Removes trace ionic/metal contaminants and finalizes cascade dump rinse/overflow rinse to $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - Sets wafer architecture context (150nm poly gate length / 180nm technology node), requiring defect-free surface preparation prior to gate oxidation to preserve critical dimensions and gate dielectric breakdown integrity.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated goniometer integration must ensure the optical baseline detection algorithm dynamically accounts for 180nm wafer chuck tilt (<0.02°) and camera optical distortion without operator intervention. Sessile drop dispensing volume jitter (>0.1 µL) directly skews the apparent Young-Laplace contact angle, meaning automated micro-syringe motor calibration and drop detachment dynamics must be interlocked with the tool's machine vision subsystem.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following SC-1/SC-2 clean, the chemically grown chemical oxide (1.0-1.5 nm) presents a hydrophilic surface (WCA < 5°). If an HF last step is utilized, the silicon surface is H-terminated and hydrophobic (WCA > 70°). The automated recipe qualification must rigidly baseline droplet evaporation rates and sessile drop settling stabilization times (typically 500 ms to 1000 ms post-detachment) to prevent transient hydrodynamic spreading from yielding false contact angle readings.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Qualification depends on high-purity HPLC/semiconductor-grade ultra-pure water (UPW) with 18.2 MOhm-cm resistivity and total organic carbon (TOC) < 2 ppb. Sourcing precision PTFE/deactivated fused silica micro-needles (gauge 30-32) and certified hydrophobic/hydrophilic calibration silicon calibration standards (PTFE-coated calibration reticles) incurs domestic supply-chain latency; secondary source equivalence must be established.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tool qualification cycle time must be bounded to allow continuous in-line monitoring during RCA wet cleaning runs without gating pilot fab throughput. The recipe qualification must establish standard 5-point and 9-point wafer mapping protocols under 3 minutes per wafer, locking in automated calibration drift tolerances before Gen 1 DRAM wafer lot dispatch.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Micro-syringe droplet volume inconsistency causing gravity-induced droplet distortion and invalid Young-Laplace fitting.
1. Organic airborne contamination during ambient wafer transfer causing rapid artificial hydrophobic drift (>15° WCA rise within 30 minutes).
1. Software baseline recognition error due to wafer bevel reflections and top-surface specular scattering.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-2-01` | **Automated 5-Point Hydrophilic WCA Qualification Post-SC-1/SC-2 Clean** | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer with automated motorized XY stage, 5 MP telecentric optical imaging, 18.2 MOhm-cm micro-dosing unit (±0.05 µL precision) | 1. Load wafer onto automated vacuum chuck and execute automatic focal plane leveling. 2. Dispense 1.0 µL ± 0.05 µL 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW droplet at 5 mapped sites (center, North, South, East, West at 10mm edge exclusion). 3. Capture droplet profile at 1000 ms post-deposition at 60 fps. 4. Execute automated circle/Young-Laplace profile extraction to calculate left and right contact angles. | `Mean WCA across all 5 points must be < 5.0°, with within-wafer standard deviation (1-sigma) <= 0.8°, and zero baseline detection failure flags.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-2-02` | **Goniometer Dosing Reproducibility and Hydrophobic DHF Surface Qualification** | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer equipped with automated micro-syringe dispenser, vision-guided drop detachment, and calibrated PTFE alignment reticle | 1. Run 10 consecutive automated sessile drop depositions of 2.0 µL UPW at 10 mm spacing along wafer diameter. 2. Measure dynamic advancing contact angle followed by static sessile drop contact angle 2 seconds post-settlement. 3. Log drop volume via automated silhouette area integration. 4. Calculate repeatability (standard deviation). | `Mean static contact angle must be >= 72.0° and <= 78.0°; dispensing volume must be 2.00 µL ± 0.05 µL across all 10 runs; static contact angle standard deviation (sigma) must be <= 1.0°.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Full-coverage static-dissipative cleanroom bunny suit with ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Non-toxic reagent. In case of minor eye or skin splash, flush with clean water for comfort. If ergonomic strain or pinch hazard occurs around motorized XY stage, disengage emergency stop immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow bench (ISO Class 4/5) with dedicated mini-environment HEPA/ULPA filtration to prevent organic hydrocarbon accumulation on freshly stripped test wafers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent UPW effluent is routed directly to standard cleanroom industrial wastewater drain; no toxic acid/base neutralization required.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ultra-Pure Deionized Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Grade (18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 2 ppb) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed (18.2 MOhm-cm) and Marangoni/IPA vapor-dried silicon wafer with uniform hydrophilic chemical oxide or H-terminated hydrophobic surface.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-qualified wafer with localized micro-droplet residue; designated for surface regeneration strip or non-product pilot monitoring archive.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Adsorption of airborne volatile organic compounds (VOCs) causes hydrophilic native oxide surfaces to exhibit artificial contact angle increase (>10° drift), leading to false RCA clean failure categorization.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full recipe qualification and process window validation of the automated sessile drop contact angle metrology tool for RCA clean evaluation, demonstrating sub-micro-liter dispensing accuracy, sub-degree angular precision, and automated pass/fail wafer mapping.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WCA_RECIPE_QUAL_REPORT_REV1.pdf`
- [ ] `WCA_5PT_9PT_UNIFORMITY_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `DROPLET_PROFILE_YOUNG_LAPLACE_RAW.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Dispensing volume repeatability across automated micro-syringe actuations** | `1.00 µL` | ±0.05 µL | High-speed telecentric droplet edge silhouette volumetric integration |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Measurement repeatability of static water contact angle on standard hydrophobic silicon** | `75.0°` | ±1.0° (1-sigma) | Automated 10-run repeatability test applying Young-Laplace baseline-fitting algorithm |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Ten consecutive automated test cycles pass volume precision (±0.05 µL) and contact angle standard deviation (<= 1.0°), automated 5-point mapping completes within 180 seconds, and metrology signoff is approved by the Metrology Lead and RCA Wet Chemistry Module Owner.

critics.systems_engineer: Automated goniometer integration must ensure the optical baseline detection algorithm dynamically accounts for 180nm wafer chuck tilt (<0.02°) and camera optical distortion without operator intervention. Sessile drop dispensing volume jitter (>0.1 µL) directly skews the apparent Young-Laplace contact angle, meaning automated micro-syringe motor calibration and drop detachment dynamics must be interlocked with the tool's machine vision subsystem.
critics.domain_expert: Following SC-1/SC-2 clean, the chemically grown chemical oxide (1.0-1.5 nm) presents a hydrophilic surface (WCA < 5°). If an HF last step is utilized, the silicon surface is H-terminated and hydrophobic (WCA > 70°). The automated recipe qualification must rigidly baseline droplet evaporation rates and sessile drop settling stabilization times (typically 500 ms to 1000 ms post-detachment) to prevent transient hydrodynamic spreading from yielding false contact angle readings.
critics.supply_chain: Qualification depends on high-purity HPLC/semiconductor-grade ultra-pure water (UPW) with 18.2 MOhm-cm resistivity and total organic carbon (TOC) < 2 ppb. Sourcing precision PTFE/deactivated fused silica micro-needles (gauge 30-32) and certified hydrophobic/hydrophilic calibration silicon calibration standards (PTFE-coated calibration reticles) incurs domestic supply-chain latency; secondary source equivalence must be established.
critics.laya_pm: Tool qualification cycle time must be bounded to allow continuous in-line monitoring during RCA wet cleaning runs without gating pilot fab throughput. The recipe qualification must establish standard 5-point and 9-point wafer mapping protocols under 3 minutes per wafer, locking in automated calibration drift tolerances before Gen 1 DRAM wafer lot dispatch.
critical_failure_modes: Micro-syringe droplet volume inconsistency causing gravity-induced droplet distortion and invalid Young-Laplace fitting.
Organic airborne contamination during ambient wafer transfer causing rapid artificial hydrophobic drift (>15° WCA rise within 30 minutes).
Software baseline recognition error due to wafer bevel reflections and top-surface specular scattering.

testcases.instrumentation: Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer with automated motorized XY stage, 5 MP telecentric optical imaging, 18.2 MOhm-cm micro-dosing unit (±0.05 µL precision)
testcases.pre_conditions: 150mm prime silicon wafer subjected to standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 clean, Marangoni dried; transfer box N2-purged (<5% RH); ambient cleanroom temperature 21.0°C ± 0.5°C.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load wafer onto automated vacuum chuck and execute automatic focal plane leveling. 2. Dispense 1.0 µL ± 0.05 µL 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW droplet at 5 mapped sites (center, North, South, East, West at 10mm edge exclusion). 3. Capture droplet profile at 1000 ms post-deposition at 60 fps. 4. Execute automated circle/Young-Laplace profile extraction to calculate left and right contact angles.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Mean WCA across all 5 points must be < 5.0°, with within-wafer standard deviation (1-sigma) <= 0.8°, and zero baseline detection failure flags.

testcases.pre_conditions: 150mm wafer processed through 0.5% dilute HF (DHF) etch to strip chemical oxide, rinsed to 18.2 MOhm-cm, and spin-dried; goniometer optical calibration verified with reference standard.
testcases.procedure: 1. Run 10 consecutive automated sessile drop depositions of 2.0 µL UPW at 10 mm spacing along wafer diameter. 2. Measure dynamic advancing contact angle followed by static sessile drop contact angle 2 seconds post-settlement. 3. Log drop volume via automated silhouette area integration. 4. Calculate repeatability (standard deviation).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Mean static contact angle must be >= 72.0° and <= 78.0°; dispensing volume must be 2.00 µL ± 0.05 µL across all 10 runs; static contact angle standard deviation (sigma) must be <= 1.0°.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses
Full-coverage static-dissipative cleanroom bunny suit with ESD footwear

q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Metrology-qualified wafer with localized micro-droplet residue; designated for surface regeneration strip or non-product pilot monitoring archive.
