# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-GONIOMETER-OPT-DISPENSER-001`
**Title:** Goniometer Optical Calibration & Automated Microliter Syringe Dispenser Integration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology > Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Recipe Qualification > Goniometer Optical Calibration & Automated Microliter Syringe Dispenser Integration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Integration  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
Establish optical magnification calibration and integrate an automated microliter syringe dispenser for sessile-drop contact angle goniometry. This procedure ensures reproducible droplet formation, precise optical edge-detection, and reliable measurement of post-RCA surface wettability for 180nm DRAM wafer processing.

---

### 2. Workflow & Execution Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["1. Mechanical Stage & Optic Alignment"] --> B["2. Optical Scale Calibration (Grid Target)"]
    B --> C["3. Syringe Dispenser Actuator Integration"]
    C --> D["4. Automated Sessile Droplet Dispense & Edge Verification"]
    D --> E["5. Metrology Acceptance Qualification"]
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Mechanical Stage & Optical Alignment
1. Mount the goniometer assembly onto a vibration-damped optical breadboard.
2. Align the optical imaging path using a fixed-focal/microscope objective assembly (such as a 10× Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) normal to the wafer sample stage.
3. Level the substrate vacuum chuck using the three-point precision kinematic mounting screws to eliminate tilt relative to the optical horizon.

#### Step 2: Optical Calibration (Pixel-to-Micron Scaling)
1. Place a certified glass calibration reticle (grid target / certified micro-scale) flat on the wafer chuck.
2. Illuminate via a telecentric or diffused LED backlight to eliminate optical diffraction and shadow blooming.
3. Acquire the calibration reticle image via the machine-vision camera.
4. Set the optical calibration factor ($\mu\text{m/pixel}$) using digital edge-detection across known fiducials, verifying that stage positioning and alignment repeatability meet Gen 2 tolerances (within $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).

#### Step 3: Automated Microliter Syringe Dispenser Integration
1. Mount a gastight microliter syringe equipped with a PTFE/passivated blunt dispensing needle onto the motorized vertical Z-drive.
2. Connect the closed-loop micro-stepper or piezo-driven syringe plunger actuator.
3. Set the needle-to-substrate standoff height using closed-loop positioning with micrometer sensitivity (down to $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity).
4. Fill the fluid path with high-purity deionized (DI) water; purge all microbubbles from the barrel and needle tip.

#### Step 4: Dispensing & Sessile Drop Analysis Qualification
1. Place a clean test wafer (or wafer coupon) on the stage.
2. Command the automated dispenser to execute a controlled sessile drop delivery:
   - Lower the needle to the calibrated pre-dispense gap.
   - Dispense a calibrated microliter droplet into contact with the substrate.
   - Retract the needle at a controlled velocity without rupturing or distorting the liquid-air interface.
3. Trigger frame capture to acquire droplet silhouette and fit baseline/tangent angles via polynomial/Young-Laplace fitting.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Validation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage & Optic Alignment Tolerance** | $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (Gen 2 standard) | Digital reticle translation check across visual field |
| **Z-Axis Actuator Sensitivity / Gap Setting** | $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ | Closed-loop encoder / micrometer readback |
| **Microscope Objective Resolution Standard** | 10× Plan Achromat, $\text{NA} = 0.25$ | Optical verification of target line-pair resolution |
| **Post-Dispense DI Water Rinse Purity** | Zero bubble inclusions / complete rinse | In-line fluidic optical transmission inspection |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations

1. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
   - *Optical configuration:* Utilization of a 10× Plan Achromat (NA 0.25) objective for feature resolution.
   - *Alignment tolerances:* Gen 1 alignment tolerance standard ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$) transitioning to Gen 2 precision ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - *Fluidics:* Rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse protocols.
2. **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose:**
   - *Gap & Height Control:* Gap and mechanical displacement control utilizing precision micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.
   - *Alignment Fiducials:* Crosshair alignment mark referencing for precision metrology and translation stability.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Optical magnification calibration must maintain sub-pixel telecentricity across the complete field-of-view; non-telecentric lens setups introduce severe drop-profile edge distortion and artificial contact angle drift (>3°) when droplet center shifts ±0.5 mm from the optical axis. Furthermore, vibration coupling between the stepper-driven microliter syringe motor and the optical base plate can induce droplet capillary oscillations during sessile drop deposition, corrupting Young-Laplace edge fitting.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate sessile drop water contact angle (WCA) metrology for RCA-cleaned silicon requires strict droplet volume repeatability in the 1.0 to 2.0 µL regime to prevent gravity-induced droplet sagging (Bond number Bo << 1). Dispenser needle gauge selection is critical: a 30-gauge blunt PTFE-coated needle is required to minimize liquid clinging, droplet pull-up hysteresis, and needle-tip meniscus perturbation during stage-assisted detachment.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial automated contact angle goniometers and Hamilton-style gas-tight glass micro-syringes face long lead times (6-10 weeks). Ensure the procurement package includes certified chrome-on-glass dot-grid calibration reticles (NIST-traceable), replacement PTFE-tipped plungers, and standardized luer-lock needles to prevent metrology downtime during wet-clean qualification runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Procurement and qualification of the automated goniometer must be completed within 14 calendar days to avoid blocking post-RCA-1/RCA-2 surface chemical passivation qualification. Baseline optical calibration and automated dispensing volume qualification must run concurrently with cleanroom air exchange certification.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Optical magnification calibration drift due to thermal expansion of the non-invar stage mounts, yielding >2.5% scale factor error and false contact angle shifts.
1. Micro-bubble entrainment within the automated syringe barrel or PTFE delivery tubing, causing non-linear volumetric displacement and droplet detachment snap-off.
1. Airborne hydrocarbon/VOC contamination of the needle tip or calibration standard inside the metrology enclosure, causing artificial hydrophobic surface drift.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-2-1-01` | **Goniometer Optical Magnification & Distortion Calibration Verification** | Digital optical goniometer with telecentric lens, 1/2-inch monochrome CMOS sensor (>=1.3 MP), and NIST-traceable chrome-on-quartz calibration target (precision micro-ball / dot array standard). | 1. Position certified 4.000 mm diameter spherical calibration standard at the center of the optical field of view. 2. Capture baseline image and execute automated edge-detection circle-fit algorithm to calculate optical scale factor (pixels/mm). 3. Translate calibration standard in X and Y directions by ±5.0 mm across the sensor field of view in 1.0 mm increments. 4. Record measured diameter and calculated optical magnification distortion at each grid position across 10 repeated measurements. | `Optical magnification scale factor must be determined within ±0.1% accuracy; optical distortion across ±5.0 mm field of view must not exceed <= 0.2%; spherical diameter measurement repeatability must satisfy 3-sigma <= 0.005 mm.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-2-1-02` | **Automated Microliter Syringe Dispenser Volumetric & Detachment Precision Qualification** | Automated micro-stepping syringe dispenser with 100 µL gas-tight Hamilton syringe, 30G PTFE-coated blunt needle, Sartorius ultra-microbalance (0.1 µg resolution), and high-speed CMOS drop-capture camera (>=120 fps). | 1. Program automated dispenser to deliver discrete nominal droplets of 1.50 µL at a dispense rate of 0.5 µL/s. 2. Dispense droplet directly onto microbalance weighing boat enclosed in anti-evaporation draft shield; record mass after 10 dispense cycles. 3. Perform automated sessile drop deposition onto hydrophobic-passivated witness wafer (DHF-dipped Si) using motorized Z-stage lift-up and retraction. 4. Quantify optical droplet profile volume and liquid snap-off vibration using high-speed imaging. | `Gravimetric dispensed droplet volume must equal 1.50 µL with CV (coefficient of variation) <= 1.5% across 10 cycles; liquid snap-off detachment perturbation must decay within <= 50 ms without secondary satellite droplet generation.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, minimum 6 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom gown, hairnet, and cleanroom booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with cleaning IPA, flush immediately with cleanroom eyewash station water for minimum 15 minutes. Inhalation of solvent vapors requires moving personnel to fresh laminar airflow area. DI water poses no acute toxicological risk.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted within dedicated laminar flow wet-metrology bench with HEPA filtration (Class 100 / ISO 5); minimal local exhaust ventilation required for isopropyl alcohol wipe station (face velocity >= 0.5 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent calibration rinse DI water routed to cleanroom industrial waste neutralizer drain (pH 6-9). IPA-soaked lint-free micro-wipes disposed in sealed hazardous waste flammables disposal bin.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deionized Water (ASTM Type I)** | `7732-18-5` | Semiconductor Ultra-Pure / HPLC Grade | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (for optical target cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `>= 99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `15 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched/cleaned silicon wafer post-HF dip (hydrogen-terminated hydrophobic Si-H) or post-RCA-1/SC-1 (chemically oxidized hydrophilic Si-OH).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-inspected silicon surface with droplet location mapped; de-wetted or marked for downstream sacrificial edge clearance prior to thermal furnace processing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Airborne volatile organic compound (VOC) adsorption and native oxide re-growth (>0.2 nm) causing rapid degradation of surface wettability (contact angle shift > 5° in ambient cleanroom air).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full optical and volumetric qualification of the automated goniometer metrology station, ensuring telecentric optical calibration accuracy, precise 1.5 µL sessile drop dispensing with Young-Laplace fitting repeatability, and verified metrology baseline for post-RCA clean wettability tracking.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `goniometer_optical_calibration_report_rev1.pdf`
- [ ] `automated_dispenser_gravimetric_qualification.csv`
- [ ] `nist_reticle_scale_distortion_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical magnification scale factor repeatability across full sensor active area** | `125.0 pixels/mm` | ±0.1% | Automated circle-fitting of NIST-traceable 4.000 mm precision calibration sphere across 9-point grid |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Automated droplet dispensing volumetric reproducibility** | `1.50 µL` | ±0.02 µL (CV <= 1.5%) | Gravimetric weighing on 0.1 µg analytical microbalance over 10 consecutive drops |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Baseline contact angle measurement standard deviation on certified hydrophobic reference surface** | `85.0 deg` | ±0.5 deg (1-sigma) | High-speed video capture with Young-Laplace edge contour fitting algorithm on certified hydrophobic standard |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Automated goniometer executes 10 consecutive 1.5 µL sessile drop depositions on calibration standards without operator intervention, achieving optical scale error <= 0.1%, volumetric CV <= 1.5%, and WCA repeatability 1-sigma <= 0.5°, with all raw datasets, distortion maps, and calibration certificates archived in the fab metrology database.

Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose (Mack, C. - Fundamental Principles of Optical Lithography)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Multi-Point Sessile Drop Dosing Recipe & Automated Image Capture Protocol Setup
**Line**: Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology / Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Recipe Qualification  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│  Stage Alignment &  │
│     Calibration     │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│   Multi-Point DI    │
│    Micro-Dosing     │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│      Side-View      │
│  Telecentric Image  │
│       Capture       │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│    Young-Laplace    │
│   Baseline & WCA    │
│       Fitting       │
│                     │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Conditioning & Stage Registration**:
   - Verify 100mm silicon wafer completed standard RCA-1/RCA-2 cleaning, followed by wafer dehydration baked at **150°C to 200°C for 30 minutes** and subsequent HMDS vapor priming (converting hydrophilic `-Si-OH` groups into hydrophobic `-Si-O-Si(CH3)3` bonds).
   - Load wafer onto the motorized goniometer vacuum chuck. Align wafer notch/flat to the home sensor, ensuring stage coordinate alignment tolerance satisfies **±5 µm** (Gen 2 standard).

2. **Automated Dispense Needle Calibration**:
   - Prime the automated micro-syringe line with HPLC-grade Deionized (DI) water. Purge air bubbles to maintain consistent micro-droplet meniscus formation.
   - Set the automated Z-axis clearance of the dosing needle to 1.0 mm above the wafer plane.

3. **Multi-Point Sessile Drop Dosing Routine**:
   - Execute a 5-point coordinate recipe across the 100mm substrate (Center, North, South, East, West with 10 mm edge exclusion).
   - At each site, dispense a controlled DI water sessile droplet at a steady dosing rate; lower the stage gently to touch off the droplet onto the wafer surface without mechanical vibration.

4. **Synchronized Telecentric Image Acquisition**:
   - Trigger side-view high-resolution optical capture (aligned back-illuminated collimated LED source paired with optical objective).
   - Capture baseline profile within 2 to 5 seconds post-dispense to eliminate evaporation distortion before measuring contact angle.

5. **Profile Fitting & Recipe Qualification**:
   - Run automated baseline detection and Young-Laplace contour fitting algorithm on each droplet profile.
   - Check surface hydrophobicity uniformity across the 100mm wafer. Ensure post-HMDS hydrophobicity is verified prior to applying downstream Shipley 1813 spin coating (targeting **1.30 µm ± 15 nm** film uniformity across the 100mm wafer).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
               Key Process & Calibration Parameters
```

1. **Stage Alignment Tolerance**: **±5 µm** (Gen 2 macro/micro positioning limit).
2. **Dehydration Bake Temperature**: **150°C to 200°C** for **30 minutes**.
3. **Subsequent Film Uniformity Baseline Target**: **1.30 µm ± 15 nm** across a 100mm wafer (Shipley 1813 spun at 4,000 RPM).
4. **Soft Bake Temperature Baseline**: **115°C** for **60 seconds** on a flat aluminum hot plate.

---

### 3. Literature Citations

- **Source: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming**:
  - *Wafer Dehydration*: Silicon wafers must be baked at 150°C–200°C for 30 minutes to desorb physisorbed water molecules.
  - *HMDS Priming*: Reactive silylation of hydrophilic silanol (`-Si-OH`) groups into hydrophobic methyl-siloxane (`-Si-O-Si(CH3)3`) bonds to increase resist adhesion.
  - *Film Uniformity*: Shipley 1813 spin recipe produces 1.30 µm ± 15 nm film across 100mm wafers.
- **Source: Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - *Alignment Tolerance*: Gen 1 is ±100 µm, improving to ±5 µm in Gen 2.
  - *Soft Bake*: 115°C for 60 seconds on a flat aluminum hot plate.

---

### Micro-Knowledge Captured
The architectural SOP specifications and domain parameters have been persisted to [docs/knowledge/sop_wca_sessile_drop.md](docs/knowledge/sop_wca_sessile_drop.md).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automating multi-point sessile drop goniometry across 100mm/150mm wafers requires rigid hardware-software synchronicity between the motorized X-Y vacuum chuck, automated micro-syringe dispenser, and telecentric high-speed CMOS camera. Vibration dampening is paramount: mechanical shutter shudder or stepper motor deceleration ringing induces capillary waves on micro-liter droplets (1-2 uL), distorting baseline fitting algorithms and corrupting contact angle evaluation across radial mapping sites.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Surface energy characterization post-RCA cleaning versus post-HF dip or HMDS priming exhibits stark contact angle polarity (<5 deg on clean chemical oxide Si-OH versus >75 deg on H-terminated or silylated surfaces). A 1.0 uL ultra-pure water (UPW) droplet dispense velocity must be finely metered (<=0.1 uL/s needle withdrawal) to avoid advancing/receding hysteresis, droplet kinetic bounce, or liquid pinning on the needle tip, ensuring Young-Laplace tangential fitting achieves sub-degree repeatability.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Disposable fluoropolymer/PTFE-coated or passivated 30-gauge Hamilton-style dispensing needles and certified optical calibration quartz graticules (calibrated drop profiles at 30 deg, 60 deg, 90 deg) face long lead times in Vietnam domestic supply lines. Sourcing semiconductor-grade 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW dispense cartridges free from organic plasticizers (phthalates) or trace surfactants is mandatory to prevent false wetting depression.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Automated 9-point or 13-point full wafer WCA mapping must execute in under 3 minutes per wafer to respect downstream queue-time budgets prior to thermal gate oxidation or HMDS priming. The protocol must run without wafer surface scratch risks or DI water residue accumulation within active die areas, designating drop locations strictly to wafer scribe lines or sacrificial edge perimeter zones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Needle-to-droplet detachment failure (liquid clinging to needle orifice rather than transferring to the hydrophilic wafer surface) causing volume variance >10% and skewed droplet geometry.
1. Organic contamination absorption from ambient cleanroom air (VOCs/siloxanes) during multi-point sequence execution, causing artificial contact angle drift >5 degrees between point 1 and point 9.
1. Optical baseline identification error caused by wafer edge bevel specular reflections or secondary mirror reflections on high-reflectivity polished silicon, leading to Young-Laplace fitting divergence.

| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-2-2-02` | **9-Point Radial Sessile Drop WCA Mapping and Image Fitting Fidelity on Hydrophilic/Hydrophobic Substrates** | Automated Wafer Goniometer with motorized X-Y vacuum chuck, telecentric illumination, and Young-Laplace / Circle fitting automated image analysis suite. | 1. Wafer B (HF-dipped) mean WCA must measure >= 75.0 degrees with intra-wafer standard deviation (1-sigma) <= 1.2 degrees. Young-Laplace fit error residuals must be < 0.5%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, acid/solvent resistant), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom Class 100 lint-free smock and ESD booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: UPW presents no toxicological hazard. In case of accidental high-pressure dispense spray to eyes, flush with standard eyewash for 15 minutes. For ergonomic skin dryness from prolonged dry N2/goniometer chamber exposure, apply standard medical moisturizer off the fab floor.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted inside laminar flow hood (Class 100 / ISO 5) with certified HEPA filtration; no toxic exhaust required, but positive pressure laminar airflow (0.45 m/s +/- 20%) is maintained to exclude airborne hydrocarbons and ambient particulates.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent UPW droplets and purge flushes routed directly to cleanroom acid-waste-neutralization (AWN) drain or standard industrial drain line without chemical pre-treatment.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ultrapure Deionized Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | SEMI C35 Tier A / 18.2 MOhm-cm at 25C | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed (18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 5 ppb) and dried post-SC-2 or post-HF dip silicon wafer with zero native oxide regrowth and zero airborne molecular organic contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized wafer with dried droplet spots confined strictly to sacrificial zones, or wafer designated as monitor witness wafer requiring re-cleaning prior to high-temperature furnace insertion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient cleanroom air causes rapid adsorption of volatile organic compounds (VOCs, plasticizers, HMDS cross-vapors) onto the pristine silicon surface, artificially increasing apparent WCA by 5 to 20 degrees and causing false-positive cleaning qualification failures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable automated 9-point sessile drop water contact angle measurement protocol delivering high-precision droplet dispensing (1.5 uL), repeatable image capture at exactly 1.0 s post-placement, and validated sub-degree Young-Laplace fitting accuracy on both hydrophilic (<5 deg) and hydrophobic (>75 deg) reference surfaces.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WCA_9PT_AUTOMATED_RECIPE_SPEC.pdf`
- [ ] `WCA_METROLOGY_QUALIFICATION_DATASET.csv`
- [ ] `WCA_DROPLET_FITTING_RAW_IMAGES.tiff`

| `ASSERT-01` | **Dispensed droplet volume reproducibility across automated syringe cycles** | `1.50 uL` | +/- 0.05 uL | Gravimetric analytical microbalance calibration over 10 consecutive automated dispenses |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Optical baseline tangent contact angle measurement repeatability on standard hydrophobic reference wafer** | `75.0 deg` | +/- 1.0 deg (1-sigma) | Automated 9-point radial goniometer inspection routine using Young-Laplace profile analysis |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Total recipe execution cycle time for full 9-point wafer mapping** | `150 seconds` | <= 180 seconds | Automated tool execution log timestamp delta between wafer vacuum clamp and unclamp |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit condition is satisfied when 3 consecutive monitor wafers pass the 9-point automated recipe without manual intervention, exhibiting volume standard deviation <=0.03 uL, Young-Laplace fitting error <=0.5%, and intra-wafer contact angle repeatability within +/-1.0 degree across all specified measurement coordinates.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-HF Hydrophobic/Hydrophilic Baseline Statistical Qualification & Gage R&R Analysis

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│         Pre-Clean: RCA-1 (SC-1) Line         │
│          70°C - 80°C (10 - 15 min)           │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Intermediate Rinse: 18.2 MOhm-cm DI      │
│               Dump Rinse 3 min               │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│             1:50 Dilute HF Dip               │
│      15 - 30 s (Oxide Strip Transition)      │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│          High-Purity N2 Blow-Dry             │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Automated Sessile Drop WCA Metrology     │
│   Baseline Hydrophobic Measurement (5 pts)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│         Statistical Gage R&R Analysis        │
│       Repeatability & Reproducibility        │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Clean & Oxide Preparation**:
   - Clean the 180nm DRAM test silicon substrates using the Standard RCA-1 (SC-1) bath (`5 H2O : 1 NH4OH [29%] : 1 H2O2 [30%]`) maintained at **70°C – 80°C** for **10 – 15 minutes** to solubilize organic surface residues and produce a uniform hydrophilic chemical oxide.
   - Execute an intermediate dump rinse using **18.2 MΩ·cm** deionized (DI) water for **3 minutes**.
2. **Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip**:
   - Transfer the wafers into a **1:50 HF:H2O** bath for **15 – 30 seconds** at ambient temperature (~25°C) to fully strip the native oxide layer and passivate the silicon surface with hydrogen bonds (transitioning from hydrophilic to hydrophobic).
   - Ensure emergency Calcium Gluconate gel is verified accessible at the wet bench prior to immersion.
3. **Quench & High-Purity Dry**:
   - Perform a quick dump rinse with **18.2 MΩ·cm** DI water to remove residual acid traces.
   - Blow-dry the wafer thoroughly using pressurized, filtered high-purity **Nitrogen (N2)** gas.
4. **Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Measurement**:
   - Transfer the dry wafer immediately to the automated optical contact angle goniometer.
   - Dispense a calibrated sessile droplet of 18.2 MΩ·cm DI water across standard 5-point layout locations (Center, North, South, East, West).
   - Capture droplet profile images and calculate baseline water contact angles using Young-Laplace edge-fitting.
5. **Gage R&R Statistical Qualification**:
   - Conduct evaluation using multiple runs/operators on calibrated standard wafers across successive cycles to evaluate repeatability (equipment variation, EV) and reproducibility (appraiser variation, AV).
   - Confirm baseline contact angle stability prior to re-oxidation or downstream unit processing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **RCA-1 Bath Temperature** | `70.0 - 80.0` | `°C` | In-situ Bath Thermocouple / RTD |
| **Intermediate Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | `MΩ·cm` | In-line Resistivity Sensor |
| **HF Strip Immersion Duration** | `15 - 30` | `s` | Wet-bench Automated Immersion Timer |
| **Intermediate Dump Rinse Time** | `3` | `min` | Dump Rinse Process Controller |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - *RCA-1 (SC-1) Chemistry & Temperature*: `5 H2O : 1 NH4OH (29%) : 1 H2O2 (30%)` at `70°C-80°C for 10-15 minutes`.
  - *Intermediate DI Rinse*: `18.2 MOhm-cm deionized water for 3 minutes`.
  - *HF Dip*: `1:50 HF:H2O dip for 15-30 seconds to strip native oxide; surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic`.
  - *Drying Method*: `Nitrogen (N2) blow-dry with high-purity`.
* **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - *HF Safety & Handling*: `Caution: Hydrofluoric acid penetrates skin and binds calcium; calcium gluconate gel must be present at all times`.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The automated sessile drop goniometer must be integrated directly adjacent to the RCA wet bench mini-environment via SMIF or purged transfer box to eliminate airborne organic hydrocarbon adsorption; droplet dispensing volume must be closed-loop controlled to 1.0 uL +/- 0.05 uL using a piezoresistive micro-dosing pump to decouple mechanical droplet kinetic impact from the dynamic contact angle baseline.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-HF silicon surfaces exhibit hydrogen-terminated Si-H bonds yielding an intrinsic water contact angle (WCA) of 75° to 86° depending on micro-roughness. Incomplete oxide stripping or premature re-oxidation from trace dissolved oxygen in DI water rinse generates residual silanol (Si-OH) groups, collapsing WCA below 65°. A Gage R&R across 3 operators, 10 wafers, and 3 repeat drops must distinguish true chemical variance from droplet volume drift and optical baseline fit errors.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard optical grade calibration sapphire standards (hydrophilic, ~10°) and PTFE reference disks (hydrophobic, ~110°) must be sourced from certified metrology vendors with ISO 17025 calibration certificates. Syringe tips must be disposable fluoropolymer-coated stainless steel (gauge 28-30) to prevent metallic contamination (Fe/Cu < 1E10 atoms/cm²) on bare silicon pilot wafers.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Executing a full AIAG MSA 4th edition Gage R&R study involves 90 automated drop runs per test set, which risks depleting available 150mm prime silicon wafers and exceeding cleanroom shift allocations. Protocol must define non-destructive wipe/re-clean pathways or coupon-level qualification before committing full-flow DRAM production lots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Rapid re-oxidation and airborne organic volatile compound (VOC) adsorption during transfer causing systematic downward drift of WCA during multi-run Gage R&R trials.
1. Droplet pin-hole wetting and optical ellipse/circle baseline fitting algorithm errors caused by surface micro-roughness and optical reflection off neighboring DRAM active area pattern steps.
1. Trace HF/fluoride salt dry-spot residue from inadequate Marangoni/spin dry causing local surface energy anomalies and non-axisymmetric droplet profiles.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-2-3-01` | **Post-HF Hydrogen-Terminated Baseline WCA Statistical Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gage R&R)** | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer with telecentric lens, CCD camera (>=60 fps), motorized X-Y-Z mapping stage, and 1.0 uL micro-syringe dispenser. | 1. Calibrate goniometer optical axis and horizontal baseline tilt using an ISO 17025 certified calibration sphere/disk. 2. Establish a test matrix with 3 trained operators, 10 freshly HF-etched pilot wafers, and 3 replicate measurements per 5-point wafer map (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right; 10mm edge exclusion). 3. Dispense a 1.0 uL droplet of degassed ultra-pure DI water at 0.5 uL/s rate at 21.0°C +/- 0.5°C and 45% +/- 3% RH. 4. Capture drop profile 3 seconds after touchdown using Young-Laplace baseline fitting algorithm. 5. Calculate total Gage R&R (%GRR), Repeatability (EV), and Reproducibility (AV) against process tolerance band of 15° (70° to 85°). | `Total Gage R&R (%GRR) <= 10.0% of process tolerance (acceptable for baseline metrology); Number of Distinct Categories (ndc) >= 5; Mean Post-HF WCA across all wafers between 75.0° and 85.0° with intra-wafer 1-sigma standard deviation <= 1.5°.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-2-3-02` | **Ambient Air Q-Time Hydrophobic-to-Hydrophilic Degradation Kinetics Verification** | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer with continuous video capture and automated multi-point stage scheduling. | 1. Position wafer on goniometer stage exposed to ambient cleanroom air (21.5°C, 45% RH). 2. Program automated dispensing of 1.0 uL ultra-pure water droplets on fresh spatial sites every 5 minutes from t=0 to t=60 minutes. 3. Record dynamic advancing, receding, and static contact angle for each discrete droplet at each timestamp. 4. Plot contact angle decay slope (dWCA/dt) to quantify chemical passivity loss and native oxide growth rate. | `Initial WCA (t=0 min) >= 78.0°; WCA degradation rate dWCA/dt <= 0.25°/min over the first 20 minutes; WCA at t=30 minutes remains strictly >= 70.0° before cross-over to hydrophilic regime occurs.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical splash face shield with ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses underneath, Heavy-duty butyl or neoprene over-gloves worn over dual inner nitrile gloves (12 mil), Acid-resistant PTFE/PVDF apron and sleeves, Acid-gas chemical vapor respirator cartridge (NIOSH approved for HF/acid mists) when handling open baths
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Calcium gluconate gel (2.5%) must be physically present and unexpired within 3 meters of the wet bench and metrology tool. For skin exposure, immediately flush with copious cold water for 2 minutes, then continuously massage 2.5% calcium gluconate gel into the affected area until medical personnel arrive. For eye contact, flush eyes at emergency eye-wash station for 15 minutes with isotonic saline or water, holding eyelids open. Seek emergency medical attention immediately; HF causes delayed, deep tissue necrosis and hypocalcemia.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench must maintain laminar downdraft with dedicated acid scrubber exhaust face velocity of 100 +/- 10 LFPM (0.5 m/s). Metrology tool chamber must be vented or exhausted to cleanroom general exhaust at >= 50 CFM.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: All spent HF/fluoride-bearing solutions must be segregated from general acid waste and plumbed directly to a dedicated Fluoride Waste Treatment System (FWTS). Neutralize with calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) or calcium chloride (CaCl2) to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge at pH 8.0-9.0 prior to discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (BOE/DHF source)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade C-1 (MOS / VLSI) | `49.0% wt (stock) / diluted to 0.5% wt` |
| **Ammonium Fluoride (BOE 6:1 component)** | `12125-01-8` | SEMI Grade C-1 | `40.0% wt` |
| **Ultra-Pure Deionized Water** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM D5127 Type E-1 (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0% wt` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic chemical/thermal oxide or post-RCA-1/2 clean state exhibiting complete water sheeting (WCA < 10°).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully hydrophobic, atomically hydrogen-terminated silicon surface (Si-H) with 100% dewet and static WCA between 75° and 85°.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Spontaneous native oxide (Si-OH) re-growth and airborne volatile organic carbon (VOC) adsorption, invalidating baseline Gage R&R statistical limits and causing unrepeatable gate oxide thickness in subsequent thermal oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Statistically validated Gage R&R and baseline qualification report establishing a robust sessile drop water contact angle measurement system capable of distinguishing post-HF hydrogen termination quality with less than 10% measurement uncertainty.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WCA_GAGE_RR_ANALYSIS_REPORT_GEN1.pdf`
- [ ] `POST_HF_WCA_RAW_DATA_MATRIX.csv`
- [ ] `DROPLET_PROFILE_CONTOUR_FITS.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total Gage R&R variance (%GRR) of the automated sessile drop contact angle metrology system** | `8.5%` | <= 10.0% | ANOVA Gage R&R calculation across 3 operators, 10 wafers, and 3 replicate runs (Minitab/JMP compliance with AIAG MSA 4th edition) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Mean static water contact angle on freshly stripped Si (100) test wafers measured within 10 minutes post-HF** | `81.5°` | +/- 3.5° (78.0° to 85.0°) | Young-Laplace profile fit across 50 measured drop sites on 10 qualified monitor wafers |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Number of Distinct Categories (ndc) discriminating capability of the measurement tool** | `6` | >= 5 | Standard MSA ndc formula: 1.41 * (Part-to-Part Standard Deviation / Total Gage R&R Standard Deviation) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful execution of the 90-run Gage R&R matrix yielding %GRR <= 10.0%, ndc >= 5, zero droplet pinning anomalies, and formal technical concurrence by Metrology Lead, Wet Chemistry Process Lead, and Quality Assurance Manager.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-RCA Surface Defect Density & Hydrophobic Passivation Mapping
**Module**: Cleanroom Chemical Processing & Metrology | **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (1T1C Folded Bitline)  
**Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Buy / Metrology Service Gate  
**Reference Document**: [docs/context.yaml](docs/context.yaml)

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Wafer Cassette     │
│        Transfer        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Laser Surface      │
│  Particle Inspection   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Automated Goniometer  │
│     Contact Angle      │
│        Mapping         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Ellipsometry Thin    │
│   Oxide Verification   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Acceptance Lot     │
│         Gating         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Post-Clean Transfer & Environmental Conditioning**:
   - Transfer wafer lot directly from the RCA-1 (organic/particle strip) / RCA-2 (metallic clean) and final HF-dip/DI-water spin rinse-dry station to the automated metrology cassette load lock within $< 15\text{ minutes}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth and airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
   - Maintain the FOUP/SMIF mini-environment at $21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and relative humidity at $40 \pm 2\%$.

2. **Automated Laser Surface Particle / Defect Density Scanning**:
   - Load wafer onto the laser surface defect scanner (unpatterned/macro defect metrology tool).
   - Set defect inspection optical sensitivity bin threshold to $\ge 180\text{ nm}$ (matching channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and critical dimension limits; resolving down to killer defect thresholds below bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform full-wafer spiral laser scatter scanning with a $3\text{ mm}$ edge-exclusion zone. Compute total defect count and area defect density ($D_0$).

3. **Multi-Point Hydrophobic Passivation & Contact Angle Mapping**:
   - Transfer wafer to the automated micro-goniometer platform.
   - Dispense sessile deionized water droplets ($1.0 \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$) at a 9-point radial map (Center, Mid-radius 4 points, Outer-radius 4 points at $R - 10\text{ mm}$).
   - Measure static contact angle ($\theta_c$) within $2.0\text{ seconds}$ of droplet contact to evaluate hydrogen-passivated (Si-H) hydrophobic surface coverage versus oxide/chemical-passivated surface state.

4. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Interfacial Oxide Profiling**:
   - Measure residual chemical or native oxide thickness across a 13-point diametric line scan to verify complete removal prior to thermal gate oxide growth ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical target) and stacked capacitor storage node contact formation.
   - Record spatial uniformity ($\sigma$) across the wafer surface.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                             ┌─────────────────────────┐
                             │░░░                      │
    Min Capacitor Charge (fF)┤░░░                      │
                             │▒                        │
Gate Ox Thickness Target (nm)┤▒                        │
  Bitline/Wordline Pitch (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   Defect Threshold Size (nm)┤█████████████            │
                             │█████████████            │
                             └┬─────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬┘
                              0    90    180   270  360 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Value & Unit | Measurement Tool / Method | Failure Mode Preempted |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Critical Defect Density ($D_0$)** | **$< 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$** at size $\ge 180\text{ nm}$ | Darkfield Laser Scattering Metrology | Bridging across Bitline/Wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ - $400\text{ nm}$), access channel shorts ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$). |
| **Surface Hydrophobic Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** | **$\ge 75^\circ$** (Uniformity $\sigma < 3.0^\circ$ across 9 points) | Automated Optical Sessile Drop Goniometer | Non-uniform Si-H termination, premature chemical re-oxidation, wet chemical staining. |
| **Residual Interfacial Oxide Thickness** | **$< 0.4\text{ nm}$** (Prior to $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxidation) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\lambda = 190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$) | Gate dielectric thickness deviation, premature breakdown of $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$. |
| **Macro Defect Clustered Fall-off** | **$0\text{ clusters}$** (Zero clustered defects $\ge 360\text{ nm}$) | Defect Spatial Pattern Recognition Engine | W-plug stacked capacitor contact opens and bitline coupling leakage degradation ($> 1\text{ fA/cell}$). |

---

### 4. Context Source Citations

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
   - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Minimum cell storage capacitance: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ to preserve noise immunity against soft errors.
   - Leakage current budget: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (governed by pre-clean surface defect mitigation).
2. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
   - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate dielectric target: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$ maintaining retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **[1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets]**:
   - $8F^2$ folded bitline cell footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Storage node capacitance budget: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ ($28\text{ fF}$ nominal).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Metrology throughput must balance queue-time exposure; prolonged darkfield optical scanning or multi-point goniometry in ambient air accelerates native oxide regrowth and airborne hydrocarbon adsorption, directly degrading the hydrophobic Si-H passivation boundary prior to thermal gate oxide growth.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: A freshly stripped Si-H surface exhibits water contact angles exceeding 75° to 85°; non-uniform contact angles across the 100mm wafer or rapid roll-off below 70° signify localized incomplete native oxide strip during the dilute HF step or trace NH4OH residue carryover from RCA-1.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Ultra-pure DI water (resistivity >= 18.2 MOhm-cm, TOC < 5 ppb) and semiconductor-grade micro-pipette fluoropolymer tips are critical consumables; uncertified goniometer calibration fluids or low-grade syringe dispensers introduce plasticizer contaminants that skew contact angle readings.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Mapping cycle time must be strictly capped at <= 8 minutes per wafer to maintain fab lot throughput and ensure the batch reaches oxidation within the allowable Q-time envelope without idling downstream furnace tracks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Rapid re-oxidation and airborne organic chemisorption during mapping causing progressive contact angle collapse and non-reproducible defect counts across lot wafers.
1. Micro-droplet residue and secondary water spotting left by sessile drop contact angle testing causing localized dielectric breakdown in subsequent capacitor dielectric deposition.
1. Scattering signal saturation on darkfield microscope from surface micro-roughness induced by over-etched RCA-1 (SC-1) bath temperatures exceeding 80°C.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-3-01` | **9-Point Sessile Drop Hydrophobic Contact Angle Passivation Mapping** | Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with micro-dosing syringe (0.5 uL ultrapure DI water droplets) and motorized X-Y wafer stage. | 1. Load wafer onto clean vacuum chuck under laminar flow. 2. Dispense 0.5 uL of 18.2 MOhm-cm DI water sequentially at 9 standardized points (center, 4 mid-radius points at r=25mm, 4 edge exclusion points at r=45mm, 5mm edge exclusion). 3. Capture high-speed baseline profile image within 2 seconds of droplet touchdown. 4. Execute circle/ellipse fitting algorithm to determine static contact angle theta for each point. 5. Immediately aspirate droplet via dry micro-vacuum tip and blow dry with filtered N2. | `Static contact angle theta >= 75.0 degrees across all 9 measurement sites; radial within-wafer variation 3-sigma <= 4.0 degrees.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-3-02` | **Full-Wafer Laser Darkfield Surface Particle and Defect Density Scan** | Automated darkfield laser surface inspection system / high-resolution motorized optical microscope (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) with side-scattering illumination and image thresholding software. | 1. Load wafer on chuck and align notch/flat. 2. Scan full active wafer area excluding 5mm outer edge perimeter using serpentine raster with 20% frame overlap. 3. Segment scattering centers using calibrated pixel intensity threshold corresponding to particle sizes >= 0.5 um. 4. Aggregate total defect count and compute defect density (defects/cm2). 5. Generate spatial wafer map identifying clustering indices and defect coordinate file. | `Total surface defect density for particles >= 0.5 um must be <= 0.35 defects/cm2 over active area; zero detected macroscopic stains, pinholes, or drying streak patterns.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical splash apron, Double nitrile gloves underneath heavy Neoprene/Viton chemical gauntlets, Full-face shield ANSI Z87.1 approved over safety glasses, Acid-resistant chemical boots and sleeves
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Calcium gluconate 2.5% topical gel immediately accessible at the station. In case of skin exposure to lingering acid trace, flush copiously with emergency eye/face wash for 5 minutes, followed by continuous massage of calcium gluconate gel into affected area until medical personnel arrive. For inhalation, relocate to clean fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet-bench exhaust hood maintaining face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) with continuous magnehelic differential pressure monitoring and scrubbed exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aspirated droplet and rinse effluents segregated into dedicated fluoride waste drains; neutralized with calcium hydroxide Ca(OH)2 to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge before aqueous discharge neutralization to pH 6.5-8.5.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (from prior DHF step residues)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C7) | `0.5% - 2.0% wt` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (SC-2 carryover)** | `7647-01-0` | TraceMetal / SEMI C1 | `< 1.0% wt` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (SC-1 carryover)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C1) | `< 1.0% wt` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C1) | `< 1.0% wt` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated silicon surface (Si-H) post-DHF rinse and N2 blow dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, defect-screened hydrophobic passivation intact; ready for immediate gate oxidation loading.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Spontaneous atmospheric re-oxidation forming uncontrolled 5-15 Angstrom native silicon dioxide (SiOx) laced with airborne volatile organic compounds (VOCs), inducing gate dielectric interface trap states (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2) and breakdown degradation in 180nm cell capacitors.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full wafer surface defect density scan and 9-point contact angle passivation map executed within allowable cleanroom queue time, validating hydrogen passivation uniformity (theta >= 75 deg) and surface particle cleanliness (<= 0.35 defects/cm2) prior to thermal furnace commit.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RCA_PASSIVATION_CONTACT_ANGLE_MAP.csv`
- [ ] `POST_RCA_SURFACE_DEFECT_DENSITY_SCAN.tiff`
- [ ] `POST_RCA_METROLOGY_CERTIFICATE.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Average 9-point water contact angle for Si-H passivation** | `80.0 deg` | +/- 5.0 deg (Min: 75.0 deg) | Automated sessile drop goniometer optical edge fitting |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-RCA full-wafer surface defect density (particles >= 0.5 um)** | `0.15 defects/cm2` | <= 0.35 defects/cm2 | Automated darkfield optical defect raster scan inspection |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 contact angle measurement locations exhibit theta >= 75.0 degrees, active area defect density <= 0.35 defects/cm2 with zero clustering signatures, and total metrology time elapsed <= 8 minutes, confirmed by researcher digital signature in the QA batch run record.

testcases.title: 9-Point Sessile Drop Hydrophobic Contact Angle Passivation Mapping
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with micro-dosing syringe (0.5 uL ultrapure DI water droplets) and motorized X-Y wafer stage.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer completed RCA-1, intermediate DHF 1:50 dip, RCA-2, and ultra-pure N2 spin/blow dry; ambient humidity 45% ± 5%, temperature 22°C ± 1°C in ISO Class 5 laminar hood.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer onto clean vacuum chuck under laminar flow.
2. Dispense 0.5 uL of 18.2 MOhm-cm DI water sequentially at 9 standardized points (center, 4 mid-radius points at r=25mm, 4 edge exclusion points at r=45mm, 5mm edge exclusion).
3. Capture high-speed baseline profile image within 2 seconds of droplet touchdown.
4. Execute circle/ellipse fitting algorithm to determine static contact angle theta for each point.
5. Immediately aspirate droplet via dry micro-vacuum tip and blow dry with filtered N2.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Static contact angle theta >= 75.0 degrees across all 9 measurement sites; radial within-wafer variation 3-sigma <= 4.0 degrees.

testcases.title: Full-Wafer Laser Darkfield Surface Particle and Defect Density Scan
testcases.instrumentation: Automated darkfield laser surface inspection system / high-resolution motorized optical microscope (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) with side-scattering illumination and image thresholding software.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer surface dry, static charge neutralized with ionizing air blower, darkfield system calibrated with 0.5 um polystyrene latex (PSL) reference sphere standard wafer.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer on chuck and align notch/flat.
2. Scan full active wafer area excluding 5mm outer edge perimeter using serpentine raster with 20% frame overlap.
3. Segment scattering centers using calibrated pixel intensity threshold corresponding to particle sizes >= 0.5 um.
4. Aggregate total defect count and compute defect density (defects/cm2).
5. Generate spatial wafer map identifying clustering indices and defect coordinate file.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total surface defect density for particles >= 0.5 um must be <= 0.35 defects/cm2 over active area; zero detected macroscopic stains, pinholes, or drying streak patterns.

ppe_required: Cleanroom chemical splash apron
Double nitrile gloves underneath heavy Neoprene/Viton chemical gauntlets
Full-face shield ANSI Z87.1 approved over safety glasses
Acid-resistant chemical boots and sleeves

cas_chemicals.name: Hydrofluoric Acid (from prior DHF step residues)

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Calcium gluconate 2.5% topical gel immediately accessible at the station. In case of skin exposure to lingering acid trace, flush copiously with emergency eye/face wash for 5 minutes, followed by continuous massage of calcium gluconate gel into affected area until medical personnel arrive. For inhalation, relocate to clean fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Dedicated acid wet-bench exhaust hood maintaining face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) with continuous magnehelic differential pressure monitoring and scrubbed exhaust ducting.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Aspirated droplet and rinse effluents segregated into dedicated fluoride waste drains; neutralized with calcium hydroxide Ca(OH)2 to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge before aqueous discharge neutralization to pH 6.5-8.5.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated silicon surface (Si-H) post-DHF rinse and N2 blow dry.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Characterized, defect-screened hydrophobic passivation intact; ready for immediate gate oxidation loading.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Spontaneous atmospheric re-oxidation forming uncontrolled 5-15 Angstrom native silicon dioxide (SiOx) laced with airborne volatile organic compounds (VOCs), inducing gate dielectric interface trap states (Dit > 1e11 eV-1 cm-2) and breakdown degradation in 180nm cell capacitors.

expected_result.summary: Full wafer surface defect density scan and 9-point contact angle passivation map executed within allowable cleanroom queue time, validating hydrogen passivation uniformity (theta >= 75 deg) and surface particle cleanliness (<= 0.35 defects/cm2) prior to thermal furnace commit.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Average 9-point water contact angle for Si-H passivation
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated sessile drop goniometer optical edge fitting

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Post-RCA full-wafer surface defect density (particles >= 0.5 um)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated darkfield optical defect raster scan inspection

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All 9 contact angle measurement locations exhibit theta >= 75.0 degrees, active area defect density <= 0.35 defects/cm2 with zero clustering signatures, and total metrology time elapsed <= 8 minutes, confirmed by researcher digital signature in the QA batch run record.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Laser Surface Particle Scanner Calibration & Defect Map Baseline Setup

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology > Post-RCA Surface Defect Density & Hydrophobic Passivation Mapping > Laser Surface Particle Scanner Calibration & Defect Map Baseline Setup  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Stage Kinematic     │
│  Leveling & Indexing   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Optical Calibration   │
│   with 365nm Source    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Radial Wafer      │
│    Mapping: 9-pt &     │
│       49-pt Grid       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Surface Scattering &  │
│     Defect Density     │
│        Baseline        │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Stage Kinematic Alignment & Leveling**:
   - Mount the calibration standard wafer onto the macroscopic vacuum stage.
   - Verify stage planar leveling and zero-reference positioning. Ensure the translation stage motion tracks within the Gen 2 positional alignment tolerance of **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.

2. **Optical Sensor & Source Alignment**:
   - Power up the scanner's high-power optical detection path configured with a **$365\text{ nm}$** optical source and objective optics (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25).
   - Calibrate the optical sensor baseline against known dark and bare silicon reference surfaces to zero out ambient photo-detector dark current and background Rayleigh scattering.

3. **Multi-Point Grid Calibration (9-Point & 49-Point)**:
   - Program the automated wafer scanner coordinate system for radial inspection using standard **9-point** and **49-point** wafer mapping grids.
   - Execute spatial scanning along the concentric radial test sites to ensure uniform sweep velocity and surface focus repeatability across the entire wafer active radius.

4. **Baseline Defect Density Map Generation**:
   - Load a pristine, post-RCA cleaned test substrate.
   - Scan the substrate over the 49-point grid, recording scatter events to establish the post-clean baseline defect and particle density signature prior to stacked capacitor cell array or thin dielectric film processing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Reference Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* |
| **Inspection Illumination Wavelength** | $365$ | $\text{nm}$ | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* |
| **Mapping Grid Density Configuration** | $9\text{ or }49$ | points/wafer | *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Transistor Channel Length Reference** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |

---

### 4. Verified Citations

- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - Macro stage alignment tolerance: *"Alignment tolerance at Gen 1 is ±100 microns (0.1 mm), improving to ±5 microns in Gen 2."*
  - Optical source: *"Exposure requires a high-power 365nm i-line UV LED source or mercury vapor lamp."*
  - Objective: *"10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25"*.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Mapping grid: *"Wafer Mapping: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs."*
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Critical feature geometry: *"Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm."*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Purchasing and commissioning a secondary-market unpatterned surface inspection system (e.g., Tencor Surfscan 6200/6420 series) for Gen 1 baseline metrology introduces significant stage jitter and optical alignment drift risks. Calibration standards using Polystyrene Latex (PSL) spheres must be strictly decoupled from cleanroom vibration nodes, and optical dark-field photomultiplier tube (PMT) gain curves must be mapped across wafer radius to prevent false edge-exclusion anomalies.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-RCA cleaned silicon presents distinct optical scattering regimes: HF-last surfaces are hydrophobic (Si-H terminated) with high native roughness scatter, while SC-1/SC-2 chemical oxide surfaces (Si-O-H terminated) exhibit distinct Rayleigh-Mie scattering cross-sections. Scanner calibration curves generated using PSL reference standards on bare oxide cannot be directly transposed to bare hydrophobic silicon without compensating for surface haze (diffuse background scattering) shifts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Acquisition of legacy laser surface particle scanners requires securing certified NIST-traceable PSL calibration deposition wafer standards (100mm, certified peak sizes at 0.2 µm, 0.5 µm, and 1.0 µm) and replacement 488nm Ar-ion or 532nm solid-state laser tubes. Sourcing verified low-run-hour replacement PMTs and cleanroom-compatible stage drive belts represents a critical lead-time vulnerability in Vietnam.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: CapEx expenditure for a dedicated automated particle scanner must justify its baseline utility against manual dark-field split-field microscope inspection. Tool qualification milestones must be tied to a strict 10-day commissioning window with zero contamination feedback into the RCA wet bench workflow before gate dielectric pre-cleans can proceed.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. PMT gain saturation or baseline drift caused by high surface haze on bare etched silicon, producing massive false-positive cluster defect storms.
1. Cross-contamination of pristine production wafers via contact with a contaminated vacuum chuck or robotic handler arm on the scanner.
1. Miscalibration of the collection optics elliptic mirror or laser beam incidence angle resulting in >30% sizing error on sub-micron particulate standards.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-3-1-01` | **NIST-Traceable PSL Particle Sizing Calibration and Count Repeatability Test** | Laser Surface Particle Scanner (488nm/532nm unpatterned wafer inspector), 100mm NIST-traceable PSL deposition standard wafer (certified peaks at 0.204 µm and 0.498 µm), clean Class 100 laminar flow hood environment. | 1. Load the 100mm PSL calibration wafer onto the vacuum chuck with notch/flat aligned at 0 degrees. 2. Execute 5 consecutive unpatterned defect scans with edge exclusion set to 3.0 mm. 3. Extract particle size distribution histogram and aggregate particle count across 0.2 µm and 0.5 µm bins. 4. Unload, rotate wafer 90 degrees clockwise, reload, and perform 3 additional verification scans to verify azimuthal stage uniformity. | `Measured PSL peak mean diameter sizing accuracy within +/- 5% of certified NIST values (0.204 +/- 0.010 µm; 0.498 +/- 0.025 µm); total count repeatability across 5 consecutive scans exhibits relative standard deviation (RSD) <= 3.5%; false defect background count in clean exclusion zones <= 0.05 defects/cm^2.` |
| `TC-RCA-CLEAN-PROCESS-3-3-1-02` | **Post-RCA Surface Defect Density and Baseline Haze Mapping Verification** | Calibrated Laser Surface Particle Scanner, Goniometer (DI water contact angle), 100mm Prime Cz Si (100) test wafers post-RCA-1/RCA-2/HF-last clean. | 1. Load pristine post-RCA cleaned prime wafer onto scanner chuck. 2. Run full-wafer scan with 0.18 µm threshold and surface haze channel enabled. 3. Log total particle count (LPDs), spatial coordinate map (X-Y point defect map), and mean surface haze in ppm. 4. Transfer wafer to goniometer and measure contact angle at 5 distinct wafer points (center and 4 orthogonal points at 35mm radius). | `Total surface defect density for particles >= 0.2 µm must be <= 0.35 defects/cm^2 across the quality area (> 3mm edge exclusion); baseline low-frequency surface haze <= 0.12 ppm; DI water contact angle >= 75 degrees (confirming complete hydrophobic Si-H passivation).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 3B/4 certified laser safety goggles (optical density OD 6+ at 488nm - 532nm), Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, powder-free), Cleanroom ESD antistatic polyester lab coat/smock, Polycarbonate splash/impact safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA, flush immediately with copious potable water for at least 15 minutes and seek medical evaluation if irritation persists. For direct laser ocular exposure, immediately shut down scanner power, protect affected eye without rubbing, and obtain urgent ophthalmological evaluation. For nitrogen asphyxiation symptoms, remove victim to fresh air immediately and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool enclosure requires dedicated clean dry nitrogen (CDA/N2) purge and local exhaust ventilation with min. 50 CFM flow to extract IPA vapor during manual chuck wipe-down. Minimum 20 cleanroom room volume air changes per hour (ACH).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipes must be sealed in airtight flammable waste bins for specialized solvent disposal. Dilute PSL standard suspension washings must be collected in dedicated aqueous non-hazardous chemical waste carboys.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 / VLSI | `99.9%` |
| **Polystyrene Latex (PSL) Sphere Suspension** | `9003-53-6` | NIST Traceable Analytical Standard | `0.1% w/v aqueous suspension` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Compressed UHP)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 5.0 (99.999% purity, filtered 0.02 µm) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed and dried hydrophobic Si-H terminated silicon surface (post-HF-last rinse, contact angle > 75 degrees) or chemically oxidized hydrophilic Si-OH surface (post-RCA-2).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Particle-mapped, defect-characterized wafer surface with untouched surface passivation ready for thermal gate oxidation or LPCVD furnace insertion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom ambient air Q-time causes uncontrolled native oxide re-growth (> 2 Angstroms/hr), airborne airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (hydrocarbons and siloxanes), and electrostatic particle accretion, permanently invalidating baseline cleanroom defect statistics.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Commissioned, calibrated laser surface particle scanner operational with certified defect sizing resolution down to 0.2 µm and repeatable defect map coordinates for 100mm wafers, providing verifiable post-RCA surface baseline defect density documentation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CAL-SCANNER-BASELINE-PSL-01.pdf`
- [ ] `WAFER-POST-RCA-DEFECT-MAP-001.csv`
- [ ] `SURFACE-HAZE-TOPOGRAPHY-BASELINE.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **NIST PSL 0.204 µm calibration sphere mean sizing accuracy on scanner** | `0.204 µm` | +/- 0.010 µm | Multi-point unpatterned optical defect scan histogram peak fitting against NIST standard certificate |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-RCA prime wafer localized light point defect (LPD) density (>= 0.2 µm)** | `0.25 defects/cm^2` | <= 0.35 defects/cm^2 | Automated full-wafer optical scatter map extraction with 3mm edge exclusion |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Optical particle scanner chuck scan-to-scan particle addition rate** | `0 particles/pass` | <= 2 particles/pass (at >= 0.2 µm) | Pre-scan and post-scan differential defect mapping over 5 consecutive cycle loads on bare wafer |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five consecutive 100mm test wafer scans demonstrate PSL sizing accuracy within +/- 5%, post-RCA baseline defect density verified below 0.35 defects/cm^2 at >= 0.2 µm, chuck cross-contamination verified <= 2 added defects/pass, and calibration report signed off by Lead Metrology Researcher and Systems Engineer.
